black"></span></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"><b>序幕　淺村悠太</b><br></span></span></div></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　９月１日，星期三，早晨──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　暑假在昨天告終，從今天起回歸上學日。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　即使如此，我們家的風景仍然和平常沒兩樣。一來老爸和亞季子小姐根本沒有什麼長假，二來我和綾瀨同學也不是會因為暑假就晚睡的人。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　早晨的餐桌前，坐著亞季子小姐以外的三人──我、老爸，綾瀨同學。亞季子小姐一如往常剛下班回來，在寢室睡覺。餐桌上擺著荷包蛋、海苔、綾瀨同學做的味噌湯，這點也和往常相同。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沙季做的味噌湯還是一樣好喝呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　老爸瞇著眼睛，以碗就口，然後感動地「呼」了一聲。我明白他的心情……但是，我家老爸反應實在太誇張了，令人有些無奈。老爸和亞季子小姐再婚而開始四人同住，已經差不多一年又三個月了，他卻還是每天早上都為了女兒的味噌湯感動。話說回來，這時候出現了與平常不一樣的部分。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不過悠太的廚藝也變好了呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　他咬著我煎的荷包蛋，一邊說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「一個荷包蛋還講得這麼誇張」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我也這麼想喔。哥哥現在不會把荷包蛋煎到焦了，蛋的形狀也很完整。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　連綾瀨同學都這麼說，讓我有些不好意思。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「可是之前的高湯蛋捲就失敗了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「弄得像炒蛋的那個？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我一時說不出話來，光是回想就覺得丟臉。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學做的高湯蛋捲很好吃，我希望自己也做得出來，於是日前有生以來第一次挑戰做高湯蛋捲。材料都準備得和食譜一樣，做起來卻一點也不順利。筷子一戳就變得破破爛爛，想把蛋捲起來時它還黏在平底鍋上，最後做出來的東西成了不僅沒捲起來，還有幾塊燒焦但勉強連在一起的玩意兒。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「再做個幾次，應該就能抓到訣竅了吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學這麼安慰我。我回：「希望如此。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「焦急也沒用吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這……也對。嗯，沒錯，我也這麼想喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不知為何，她講得一副感同身受的樣子。但是我在想，或許這點不限於做菜。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我想起這個暑假的考前衝刺集訓。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　周圍的人水準都很高，讓我焦慮到沒辦法好好睡覺，反而導致念書效率低落。原本那麼想進的大學居然不是為了自己而考的，發現這點時我真的無地自容。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我先前一直將方針訂為「考上比能力所及範圍更好的學校」。不過說實話，如今我卻在煩惱這樣到底好不好。將志願校訂為慶陵真的好嗎？自己真正想進的學部是哪個？到了九月的這個階段還沒確定或許太慢……然而實際上就是還沒決定，這也無可奈何。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　藤波同學點出問題後，我改變了想法。不是為別人，而是為自己，因為想找到一份好工作、因為自己想讀──所以要考大學。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　當然，我也想和綾瀨同學維持良好關係，想珍惜與她共度的高中生活。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這麼說來，悠太、沙季，亞季子和我提起三方面談，說時間應該快到了。去年是在九月底吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「日程還沒問，不過我想會在差不多的時間。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我在旁邊點頭附和。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「應該和沙季說的一樣。在那之後，就只剩下個人面談了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　考大學並非考生一個人的事。報考大學需要花錢，考上了還要繳學費。如果就讀離家很遠的大學，住宿多半也要花錢。即使學費以獎學金抵掉、生活費靠打工薪水解決，我們依舊還沒成年，處於雙親庇護之下而不能隨心所欲。三方面談的主旨之一便在於進行這部分的調整。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「無論你們要讀哪一所學校，我們都會盡量幫忙喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　老爸微笑著說道。綾瀨同學老實地低下頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「謝謝爸爸，我會努力考上的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳的志願校還是一樣吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學的第一志願是月之宮女子大學。真要說起來，她去年才對這間學校有所認知，是班導推薦的，所以當時在場的亞季子小姐也知道。三方面談過後不久，綾瀨同學就去了月之宮的校園開放日，似乎就是在那時對這所學校有了更進一步的認識。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: black"><span style="color: #000000">　　校園開放日啊……</span></span></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　高中三年級的秋天跑去大學的校園開放日，以升學校水星高中的學生來說算是相當晚，或者該說太沒有自覺……但是晚去總比不去來得好吧？此時我是這麼想的。</span></span><br><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「悠太還在考慮嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是啊，我想在三方面談前把範圍再縮小一點。還有──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我看向綾瀨同學，她默默點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「──我會試著問問看，今年是否也能和沙季排在同一天。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這樣對我和亞季子來說是幫了個大忙……可是沒關係嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我們早就不介意了。何況就算讓人家知道，也不會有什麼困擾。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們是沒有血緣的兄妹，這點是事實。的確，老爸再婚使我突然有了個就讀同一所學校的同齡妹妹，會讓人家以有色眼光看待，但我們已經決定不要在外面表現得像是陌生人了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「亞季子也會很高興的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　正巧，亞季子小姐打開寢室的門，走向洗手間，身上還穿著睡衣。老爸趕緊起身，拿出冰箱的麥茶倒了一杯，遞給從洗手間出來的亞季子小姐。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　他們順便又講了幾句話，不過老爸很快就回來了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「面談的事我已經說嘍。她說等明確的日程出來之後告訴她。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「居然這個時間爬起來，以媽媽來說還真稀奇。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　因為她總是天亮才回家睡覺，早餐時間應該睡得正熟。綾瀨同學這麼說完後，老爸點點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「畢竟關掉冷氣後，氣溫還是太高了嘛，大概是熱醒的吧。我告訴她開著冷氣會比較好。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　原來如此，那杯麥茶是避免脫水啊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「因為媽媽不太喜歡吹冷氣……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　話雖如此，不過睡覺時水分依舊會流失，儘管已經是九月，大白天依舊有脫水的危險。應該照老爸說的那樣，打開冷氣設定好溫度，也別忘記補充水分。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我一覺得熱就會開冷氣，可是亞季子怕冷嘛。不過等到冬天，就換我不喜歡開暖氣了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那麼，你們會關掉暖氣？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不，我沒她那麼排斥啦。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　老爸說話時臉上還掛著笑容，該不會是在炫耀他們很恩愛吧？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「畢竟亞季子過著晨昏顛倒的生活嘛，她應該比我更需要注意身體。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「爸爸工作也很忙，希望你多愛惜自己的身體……啊，這是媽媽說的喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這、這樣啊。嗯，我當然有注意就是了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　居然能看見手裡還拿著筷子的老爸害羞抓頭。一年前完全想不到會有這種事。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　好啦好啦，你們兩個還是一樣恩愛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　老爸和我之前的媽媽處得不好而離了婚，現在看見他和亞季子小姐這麼恩愛，我也很開心。但是開心歸開心，老爸一大早就勤快地奉上麥茶給亞季子小姐先不論，接下來又換亞季子小姐一邊道謝，一邊貼心地幫他把領帶弄正，實在不像一對有高三子女的夫妻，或者該說他們還年輕？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我不禁同樣在意起自己身上制服的領帶，於是把手伸到頸部調了一下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在這時，有人在桌下「咚、咚、咚」地輕輕踢了我的小腿三下，踢我的是綾瀨同學──這是暗號──我也有同感，於是輕輕踢了回去。咚、咚、咚，三下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我吃飽了。很好吃喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著，老爸端著吃完的餐具起身。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「放在流理台就好，我們會洗。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這樣啊，不好意思。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「哪裡，畢竟爸爸最近工作還是很忙吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「還得再忙一陣子。那我走嘍。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　大概是工作積了不少吧。雖然比平常提前五分鐘吃完，老爸依舊焦急地抱著公事包衝出家門。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學向老爸的背影道別。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　接著回頭吃自己的早餐。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　洗完碗盤之後，準備出門。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　踏出家門前，我們給彼此一個擁抱。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　夏祭後，我和綾瀨同學之間多了個新規矩。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　為了避免任一方想要感受溫暖時強迫另一人接受，我們定下徵求同意的暗號，有點像在玩間諜遊戲，某方面來說這種行為很孩子氣。不過，即使在別人眼裡像個大人，我們畢竟還是高中生，依然是嚮往這種暗號的年紀。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　相擁的我們閉上眼睛。看見方才老爸對於亞季子小姐的疼惜，綾瀨同學好像也有了些想法。感受彼此的溫暖數秒之後，我們各自退開。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果在我們擁抱之際，亞季子小姐碰巧起來，又或是老爸忘了東西而回來拿，會怎樣？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　或許會被看見。即使如此，對我們來說，這幾秒鐘仍舊很寶貴。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說不定，在我心底的某個角落，藏有「被看見也無所謂」……不，甚至是「最好有人看見」的念頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那我們走吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「等一下。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著，綾瀨同學的雙手伸向我的頸部，握住領帶。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「歪掉嘍。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，嗯……謝謝。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們並肩走向通往學校的路。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我將和既是義妹也是女友的她，共度第二個秋天。</span></span><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　　　<b>９月15日（星期三）　淺村悠太</b><br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「夏天啊……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看著萬里無雲的藍天，丸咬了一口三明治。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　儘管天空漸漸變高，陽光依舊很強。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　受他影響，我也跟著仰頭。我們待在開放式走廊一角，呆呆地望著天空。清風令人心曠神怡。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　連接兩棟校舍的走廊穿過中庭邊緣，正值午休的此刻，許多學生會來這裡搶占擺在草地上的長椅。我和丸久違地打算一起吃午餐，因此到合作社買了麵包飲料後來到這裡尋求空位。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　遺憾的是，長椅坐滿了。不得已的我們兩個只好像這樣，待在能俯瞰中庭的二樓走廊正中央，邊曬太陽邊閒聊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「你說夏天，但是九月都過一半了耶？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「雖然月曆上已經是秋天，不過從天文學角度來看，九月的十五日還是夏天。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　丸吸著紙盒裝飲料，露出柴郡貓般的奸笑。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「算了，夏天就夏天吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這樣才好，因為會讓人感覺準備考試的時間還很充裕。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然丸這麼說，但是高三的九月需要這種「充裕」嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我希望時間真的充裕，不是只有感覺。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒人有那麼多時間啦。那些看起來行有餘力的傢伙都是裝出來的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　據說很擅長分析對手心理的前棒球社正捕手這麼表示。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是這樣嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就當成是這樣吧。被人家嚇唬到可是會輸掉的喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不過我覺得會說出這種話，證明丸自己也感受到了壓力。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我在他旁邊喝著紙盒裝飲料。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　中庭吹來的風流向操場，輕撫草地產生條紋狀波浪後，接著又在過廊上掠過女生的後頸，使裙襬、髮絲隨之搖擺，這才離開水星高中，去向遠方。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和丸默默地並肩而站，任風吹拂。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「很久沒這樣了呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我也很久沒和淺村像這樣悠哉聊天了呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　嗯，確實如此。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　分到不同班級後，和丸好好聊天的時間確實減少了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　至於幾個以前同班時會聊上幾句的同學，重新分班至今更是完全沒說過話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和丸最近也沒什麼談話的機會。他忙著準備夏天的最後一次大會，再加上暑假起我把時間全花在準備考試上頭，因此我們幾乎不會湊在一塊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「從棒球社引退之後，過得怎樣？身為前隊長會去關心後輩們嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我們有優秀的二年級在，用不著擔心。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「大會……真可惜。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「實力不足，僅此而已。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　丸說得很平淡，但是不可能不感到懊悔。甲子園地方預賽敗退後，他就像得了燃燒殆盡症候群一樣。偶而收到他傳來的簡訊，也都在說自己沒幹勁，提不起勁念書。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　而這種狀況，在暑假中段有了轉變。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　差不多是我結束考前衝刺回來的時候吧，收到的簡訊裡正面積極的變多了，所以我不怎麼擔心他。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這麼說來，你和綾瀨沒來煙火大會呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「實在沒空出來玩嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊～這個嘛……嗯……是啊，沒那個空吧～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　實際上，除了七月的一日露營外，我們都沒空出去玩。但其實我和綾瀨同學去了一次煙火大會，那場煙火大會似乎是奈良坂同學告訴綾瀨同學的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　難道說，奈良坂同學號召的那次集會，丸也有參加？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然我平常不會管誰和誰見面，但這回要說不在意就是假的，畢竟牽扯到綾瀨同學了嘛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這樣啊。賭輸了呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「……怎麼回事？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「還以為你會和綾瀨兩個人去呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不愧是擅長心理戰的棒球社主將，想讓我動搖後說出真相是吧？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「雖然不曉得你打了什麼賭，不過輸掉還真令人遺憾啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我這麼迴避之後，丸只是哼了一聲，沒有追問下去。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「算啦，就當是這樣吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　……看這個反應，果然穿幫了嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「真像淺村的作風啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「換成一般男生，要是和綾瀨一起去了煙火大會，豈止告訴朋友，恐怕還會在學校裡大肆宣傳。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「為什麼？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「有個漂亮的女朋友可以對其他男生炫耀吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我真的不懂，但據說就是這樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「丸也會？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「之前也說過，我拿綾瀨那種類型沒轍。這個嘛，如果試著聊上幾句，或許會發現她真的像你講的一樣為人不壞……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「身為哥哥可以保證，她是個好孩子，而且信得過。在某些場合甚至比我還要可靠得多。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　丸知道我和綾瀨同學是沒有血緣的兄妹，說這些話不至於出什麼問題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「或許是吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「……這裡其實可以稍微反駁一下耶？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　轉換話題吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「唉呀，畢竟大考就在眼前嘛。文化祭也快到了，等活動結束之後，大概就得專心準備考試了吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「本來想看的夏季動畫只消化了一半左右，真不甘心……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我也有不少書堆著沒看喔。話說回來，你居然還看了一半。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「打亂平常的步調可不行啊。如果不保持平常心，能解開的問題也會解不出來。唉呀，看動畫正好可以放鬆一下。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果看大量動畫放鬆還能考上大學，那可真是厲害。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「你覺得沒問題？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我問丸，雖然答案大概猜得到。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「已經拿到東大Ｂ判定了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我不禁瞪大眼睛看著好友，應屆有這種水準未免太厲害了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「私立也要報考嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「姑且還是會啦。為了避免落榜，會去考早稻穗、慶陵。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那兩間的水準可不是讓人避免落榜的耶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。因為我總算有了幹勁，既然要考就要考最好的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　似乎已經切換成應考模式的好友望著天空，說出自己的決心。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　剛剛丸是這麼說的──你沒來煙火大會呢。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　換句話說，他應該有去煙火大會。我不禁冒出一個想法──或許就是因為有了這種放鬆身心的機會，他才能轉換心情。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看見丸堅定的側臉，感覺得到他已經調適完畢，要準備面對自己接下來的路。至於那是怎樣的路，我還沒問就是了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這樣啊。加油。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　以丸的個性來看，他會訂立明確的目標，才選擇要進哪一間學校吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　要報考的學校啊……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「光顧著擔心別人，你自己又怎樣啊，淺村？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。雖然有點晚，不過我還在思考上大學之後想要做些什麼。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「在我看來啊，這年頭已經決定好的人比較罕見喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不過丸已經決定了吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是啊。但說不定讀到一半會改變想法……嗯，我覺得改變也不錯。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到丸這幾句話，我有些疑惑。這是什麼意思？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我還以為升學是影響將來的大事。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「焦慮會導致視野狹隘，讓選擇變少。父母曾經告訴我，大學並不是終點。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我好像是第一次聽到丸提起父母。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「原來……如此？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我老爸甚至還這麼說過──不要害怕改變主意，最好別以為大學就會決定將來的一切。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這……話是這麼說沒錯啦。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　可是啊，我沒有餘力這麼想也是事實。大考就是會讓人產生「如果在這裡失敗，人生就完了」的念頭。我們的人生經驗可沒有豐富到能夠相信「無論讀哪間大學都救得回來」這種樂觀想法。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「話雖如此，有個目標動力會比較強也是事實呢。所以說，淺村仍處於不曉得該做什麼才好的狀態，對嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我點點頭。一點也沒錯。事到如今才談這些有些晚，但我的確找不到自己進了大學想做什麼、該做什麼。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「總覺得沒什麼頭緒。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，讓我想想。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「有什麼建議嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　正所謂溺水者就算只是根稻草也想抓……呃，我沒說丸是稻草。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「把它言語化吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「意思是？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「人類呢，是一種不擅長思考的生物。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不擅長思考……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這種說法相當有趣，很符合丸的風格。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「想法只留在腦袋裡，不會發現都是在原地打轉，所以要把它言語化。具體來說，就是要嘗試把它寫出來。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「有什麼不一樣嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「有。實際把腦袋裡的想法化為文字輸出到紙上，能讓人重新整理思緒。就算只是隨手做筆記也無妨，日記或備忘錄也行喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「日記啊……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這麼說來，我沒寫過日記呢。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　整理自己腦袋裡的想法，是嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　試試看吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　穿越過廊的風，不知何時已經停了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　午休結束，下午的課開始。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　負責日本史的教師在校內是出了名地怪，行事不合常理的人真的到哪裡都有。我看著他在眼前華麗地偏離教科書範圍，心想該怎麼有效利用這段時間。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　照這樣看來，所剩的三十分鐘，一定會閒聊到下課。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不過嘛，班上同學都有心理準備。據說這位老師負責的日本史每年都教不完，近代部分要趕課──這是諸位學長姊透過有參加社團的人轉告我們的。每三節課會有一節像這樣嚴重離題，教學進度延遲也是難免。在這種情況下，定期考試的範圍卻依舊遵照教學綱要安排。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學滿面笑容地聽著離題的日本史，看起來很開心。自稱喜歡歷史的她聽得心滿意足，彷彿離題到教科書範圍之外的部分才是重點一樣。不僅如此，她還會發問。這麼說來，上次離題談到了平安女流作家之間的交流，回家之後她一再表示很有趣。遺憾的是，我只聽了一半，剩下的時間都在偷念其他科目，所以跟不上對話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這回我同樣沒聽老師到底講了些什麼，而是在思考身為考生該怎麼有效利用剩下的時間……不，慢著，這種時候不是正好可以像丸所說的那樣，把時間拿來整理自己的思緒嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我，重視的是什麼？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　今後想做什麼？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我把筆記本翻到空白處，握住自動鉛筆。那就開始吧……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　腦袋裡面想的啊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　首先，我喜歡什麼呢？喜歡的東西……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　──我喜歡書。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　正確說來是喜歡看書吧。並非對書本這樣的物體有什麼偏愛，電子書或紙本書都可以。我在「喜歡書」的那一行下面寫上「看書」並圈起來，拉出一個箭頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然後試著讓思緒進一步發展下去。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　為什麼喜歡看書呢？我試著回想自己喜歡的那些書。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這麼說來，除了小說之外，我也喜歡閱讀知識性書籍，因為能提供新鮮的觀點，讓我產生「原來如此，還有這種思考方式啊」的念頭。而這樣應該有助於避免偏見或視野狹隘。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　──我喜歡接觸新的思考方式。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　或許是這樣吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　寫到這裡，我暫時打住思緒，抬頭環顧周圍。要是老師又開始上正課就不妙了。然而不出所料，老師還在離題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　喜歡的東西……喜歡的東西啊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咖啡」、「擔擔麵」、「麻婆豆腐」……我試著把各種想到的寫出來，雖然主要是食物。我喜歡吃辣……感覺突然變庸俗了，不過嘛，我確實喜歡。我是不太挑食的人，所以這些都只是「如果硬要挑幾樣出來」的程度。喜歡的東西……喜歡的東西啊。物質方面的我想不太出來耶。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我試著回想自己的房間。裡面擺了些什麼呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　書愈堆愈多。雖然因為收納空間有限，我最近盡可能改買電子書，不過除了書以外就沒什麼東西了。我不像丸那樣喜歡蒐集模型或壓克力立牌，對音樂也沒什麼堅持，僅管會看動畫也會看電影，但不會看訂閱範圍外的作品。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　喜歡的東西……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　──沙季。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　呃，把這個寫在筆記本上實在很不好意思。不過誠如丸所言，就是因為我把這些都留在腦袋裡，思緒才會在原地打轉……不不不，要是被別人看到未免太丟臉了……呃，經過一番猶豫後，我在空白處寫下了小小的「ＳＡＫＩ」。若是這麼寫，乍看之下應該看不出來。拜託就這麼放過我吧。雖然我也不知道自己是向誰求饒。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　總而言之，必須讓思緒往前走。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　喜歡的東西暫且到此為止。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　換句話說──我瞪著筆記本思索──我喜歡的東西就是這些。所以，我到底想做些什麼呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　──希望盡快自立。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　為什麼？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　可以成為綾瀨同學的支柱、能夠減輕老爸的負擔……嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　把這些好好寫下來後，我看著寫出來的東西，發現一個問題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　慢著慢著慢著，這不是「我想做的事」吧？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果我沒遇上綾瀨同學呢？如果老爸是石油王呢？若是這種狀況，想要盡快自立的理由就會全部消失，到時候，也就等於沒有任何想做的事了。換句話說，認識綾瀨同學以前的我、高中一年級時的我，將來沒有任何想做的事？是這樣嗎？我是否像藤波同學所說的那樣，硬是替自己的行為加上動機呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　無論是珍惜綾瀨同學還是想讓老爸輕鬆，都是真的也都很重要。而這種想法也塑造了如今的我。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　但是，應該不止如此吧？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　直覺告訴我，我在隱藏自己想做的事，是故意讓自己看不見的。我有這種感覺，感覺得到。然而──它的真面目究竟是什麼？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　嗯……我不知道……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　沒辦法。既然不知道自己想做什麼，那就試著思考自己做得到什麼吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我做得到的……嗎？我不擅長與人往來……原本自認是這樣，不過最近有所不同。我擅長接待客人，並不是「喜歡」，然而「擅長」……應該說是習慣，或是不會覺得痛苦吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在書店打工，讓我感覺到自己喜歡思考書本的排列方式，這和讀賣前輩、來書店的客人告訴我他們是怎麼找到書購買的有很大的關係。換句話說，人類的行動有規律性，即使無法預測個人的行動也不要緊，只要用「造訪書店的顧客」這種粗略的觀點來看，就能找出排書的原則。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「暢銷書要讓它顯眼」也是其中之一。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　所謂的暢銷書，代表也能賣給不會熱心找書的輕度客群，所以必須把它擺在顯眼的地方，讓人容易找到，否則輕度客群根本不會去找。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　反過來說，也有些只能賣給少數熱心讀者的書。就算書擺得有些隱密，這種重度使用者依舊會自己把它找出來，所以放到書店深處也不成問題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　至少讀賣前輩似乎是這麼想的。而且她說過，她就是照這樣的邏輯整理書架。我覺得這很有趣，也喜歡思考這方面的事。先不管擅不擅長，思考這些時同樣不會讓我感到痛苦。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看樣子，我雖然覺得和其他人往來很麻煩，卻喜歡思考人類這種生物的行為，而且樂此不疲。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　將思緒大致寫下來之後，我空了一行，試著寫出想要報考的大學。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一之瀨大學，私立學校的話就是早稻穗、慶陵……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在對於就業有利的範圍內，盡量選擇比較好的學部。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果只看想做的事，大概會變成文學部，但從就業角度來看，經濟學部、法學部之類的會比較好……嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　寫到這裡，我停下動作。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　……等一下。我再次盯著自己的筆記。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　有些不對勁。真要說起來，比較好的學部指的是什麼？偏差值高的學部嗎？大概是這樣吧。畢竟現代依然是看重偏差值的學歷社會，學歷高對於人生有利……有利？呃，有利與否該在這時候寫出來嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我不禁倒抽一口氣。為什麼我會這麼想？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　試著想像一下。舉例來說，如果有人說：「我付錢，想吃什麼都可以。」就會想要盡量吃貴一點的東西，這點我懂。但在決定想要吃什麼時，會因為買得起比較昂貴的東西就改變選擇嗎？這不是本末倒置嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　現在的重點是想吃什麼──不對……呃，是我想做什麼。我明明是為了找到這個問題的答案，才像這樣把想法寫出來的……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在面對「你描繪的將來是什麼樣子」這樣的問題時，卻給出「盡可能考進好一點的學部」這種曖昧的答案，是在開玩笑嗎？這就等於告訴人家，自己將來去哪裡都行，等考上之後再思考要做什麼工作。明明是在選擇可能對就業帶來重大影響的學部耶。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　當然，如果真的什麼都沒決定，這樣也是可以，或者該說只能這麼做。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　可是現在我所做的，應該是老實地把自己腦中所想吐露出來。什麼實現的可能性該往後挪。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我有點絕望。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一切都曖昧不清，不上不下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　為什麼「自己想學什麼」、「自己想做什麼」，會如此難以決定？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我想起剛剛丸說的話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不要害怕改變主意。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我不禁毛骨悚然。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就是這個……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　改變主意。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　到目前為止我都沒有多想，一直覺得為了增加選項而去比較好的地方是正解……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不是這樣。不是沒有多想，而是不願多想。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　人生總會碰上無能為力的時候，希望不見得會實現，這點我早在上小學之前就明白了。小學落榜，國中落榜，然後母親離家出走。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就連愛情都會變，明明已經在神明面前發誓要永遠。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　所以我放棄懷抱希望。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　只要不決定想做什麼，便不會因為無法實現而受傷。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　難道說──我就是因為這樣的理由，放棄思考自己想做什麼嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不，慢著……我應該是在思考自己將來想做什麼吧……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我不禁輕聲嘀咕，接著回過神來打量周圍，但似乎沒人聽到……好險。這種時候就得感謝台上離題到口沫橫飛的老師。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看著雜亂無章的筆記，我在坐立難安中迎接下課時間。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　放學後，我抵達打工的書店，決定趁著還沒開工在店內轉一下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　走在書本叢林間的我，沉浸在書的美好之中。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　書的氣味令人安心。儘管對於實體書沒有堅持，但如果問喜不喜歡，我想我還是會說喜歡。無論是欣賞漂亮的裝幀、翻閱紙製的內頁、嗅聞書頁間飄出的墨水味──我都不排斥。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「也有段時間沒確認新刊了呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我看著在平台上堆成書塔的作品封面，輕聲說道。這種時候，就會讓人體會到自己正逢應考年。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　差不多該上工了，於是我走向裡面的辦公室。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　今天是久違的打工，況且包含最近很少見到的讀賣前輩在內，綾瀨同學和小園繪里奈同學也都有排班。換句話說，讀賣前輩與新生代很難得地全部到齊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　先說了聲「我要進來嘍」之後，我打開辦公室的門。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　其他三人已經換上制服等待。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔～後輩，早啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「呃，早安？嗯，小園同學午安。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「午安，淺村前輩。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　坐在小園同學身旁的綾瀨同學也輕輕向我點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「淺村同學很悠閒呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我在店內稍微轉了一下才過來。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔，原來是這樣啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學這麼說道，小園同學則是一臉有話想說的表情看著她。注意到小園同學的目光後，綾瀨同學轉過頭去。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯……什麼事，小園同學？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「呃，沒什麼啦，綾瀨前輩……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著，小園同學表情一變。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不懷好意地揚起嘴角。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我只是在想，你們還是一樣用姓氏稱呼彼此呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這很正常吧，現在是工作時間。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不過，要是這間店來了另一個叫淺村的人，要區分不是會很麻煩嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　小園同學說完，讀賣前輩同樣露出不懷好意的微笑。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「呵呵呵！這樣的積極性不錯耶。嗯，我認為日本人應該多用名字稱呼彼此，這樣顯然對於個人比較尊重。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就是說嘛！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這個嘛，我不否認。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學和往常一樣，面不改色地說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「可以嗎？可以吧？是不是想太多啦？我想我應該不會輸給那種顧慮一堆的人喔。我要先喊嘍？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「請。話說回來，為什麼要講『應該』？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗚，有什麼關係嘛！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「也就是說，為了能夠更親近一點，小園妹妹想要用名字稱呼後輩吧？很好很好，妳就試試吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　別在那邊偷笑，妳就不能出面制止嗎，讀賣前輩？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「收到。那、那麼……呃……前輩，你的名字是什麼啊？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在這個時候，綾瀨同學無奈地以手掩面。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我叫悠太。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，好，謝謝前輩。呃……悠他他。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那是誰啊？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咬到舌頭了。悠、悠……太太。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒必要紅著臉說吧？不用勉強喔？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚。前輩，真虧妳能做出這麼不好意思的行為耶！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我可沒有。我喊的是淺村同學。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學講得神色自若。不過妳在家是喊我「悠太哥」吧？而且喊很久了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在現場氣氛隱隱有些尷尬時，店長敲門走了進來。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　他說時間差不多了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不知不覺離上工只剩下五分鐘，我們一同起身。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　正當大家收拾茶杯、做各種準備之際，讀賣前輩突然叫住我。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「對了對了，如果看到想買的書，最好趁還買得到時多買幾本喔～」<br><br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><img loading="lazy" src="https://res.lightnovel.fun/images/260521/8e314572b05cdbf16b31a7de1eb29ed5.jpg?m=tXxc3Xy7wVNQj3CaK2Xz6Q&amp;t=1781007686" img-width="1384" img-height="2048" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　</span>她的表情相當認真。<br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔……可是我沒有買那麼多書的錢，也沒有時間看，畢竟我是考生。而且買了還要找地方擺。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「只要房間還能讓人走路就沒關係！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　讀賣前輩立刻插嘴打斷我。不不不，妳打算堆到連地板都看不見嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「該不會……前輩的房間看不見地板？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「只要把書撥開就能走路。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「又不是雪國。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　腦中浮現了一個床周圍堆滿書的房間。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我說啊，我是在告訴你，趁還買得到書的時候趕快買比較好。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽她語氣嚴肅，我不由得詢問究竟是怎麼回事。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「今天的新聞，你沒看嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span
