style="font-family:Arial">　　一間知名出版品經銷商倒閉的新聞。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　經銷商是出版業界不可或缺的存在，印象中是個地位穩固的行業。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「雖然已經是有名的老字號了……唉，讓人有世事無常的感覺。雖然這種事無論哪一行都有可能發生啦。身為還在找工作的人，實在沒辦法忽視這條新聞。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們三人點點頭。若是這樣就能理解。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「該不會，前輩找工作時也有考慮……呃，經銷商？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，保險起見嘍，當然也有考慮其他工作啦。除了歷史悠久的大企業之外，也有資訊、網路類型的廣告代理商等，這些我都有應徵。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「應徵這麼多種啊？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　對於綾瀨同學的問題，讀賣前輩點點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　原來如此。想要從事的行業出狀況，會讓人擔心這條路不好走。按照讀賣前輩的說法，光是列出最近幾個月的經濟新聞標題，就有老牌汽車廠被收購、知名電器製造商被收購、銀行凋零等，能看見這些年來堪稱日本主力產業的幾個行業有所變化。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　還是高一生的小園同學看來沒什麼感覺，不過我和綾瀨同學也在考慮將來的出路，所以感同身受。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就算能從月之宮畢業，要找工作還是很辛苦呢……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學這兩句話看來同樣是發自內心。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不過嘛，反正內定已經到手，處於有得選的立場，所以我其實不太擔心。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　總算展露笑容的讀賣前輩說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「好啦，那我們上工吧。收銀台先由我和後輩站，妳們兩個負責整理書架。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　讀賣前輩這麼表示，催我們動身。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然而，聽到這些後，更讓我懷疑起自己追求穩定的想法是否正確。讀賣前輩說，在一個變化很大的時代，無論業界歷史多悠久、公司規模多大，都有可能明天就衰退。既然如此，「盡可能進一所好大學、找一份好工作」這種程度的模糊認知，究竟具備多少價值呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　當然，如果是好好調查、思考過後的認知，自然是另一回事。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　但要是像我這樣僅僅出於一些模糊概念所想到的「好大學、好工作」，會不會只是空中樓閣呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　走向收銀台的途中，讀賣前輩補充：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「等到後輩你們大學畢業時，世間的風景或許又變了個樣喔～說不定會是個充滿了新公司、新工作、新職場形態的時代呢～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　──喜歡接觸新的思考方式。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我在筆記本上這麼寫。可是──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　救救我。我沒有預測未來的能力，無法連還沒出現的職業也考慮到。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　當天晚上，我和綾瀨同學一邊看電視一邊吃晚飯。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們沒待在餐廳，而是坐在起居室的沙發上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　擺在電視機前方矮桌上的主菜，是該稱為「ＴＨＥ．日本家庭料理」的馬鈴薯燉肉。我們都是打工回來，所以決定把亞季子小姐出門上班之前做好放著專門對付老爸的必殺料理加熱一下就好。除此之外再加上白飯、味噌湯，配菜則是回家途中去超市買的熟食、納豆、海苔。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　順帶一提，老爸已經吃完回房間，大概睡了吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　話說回來，明明成員只有向來會在吃飯時專心用餐的綾瀨同學，以及不怎麼看電視的我，今晚卻偏偏在起居室吃的理由是──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　受到讀賣前輩那番話影響，我們想說偶爾也該好好看一下新聞，於是像這樣看起了夜間專門播報經濟新聞的節目。這是個追蹤世界級商業焦點的棚內節目，我和綾瀨同學邊看邊討論，同時動著筷子。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，就是這個吧，讀賣前輩說的倒閉。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我點點頭，繼續看新聞。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　畫面上那位受歡迎的主播，一邊聽號稱專家的經濟學者解說，一邊帶話題，好比說重整業界要如何如何、年輕人不看書如何如何。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「書賣得那麼差嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到綾瀨同學這句話，我回她一句：「這就難說了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「紙本書的銷售量或許真的下降了，但也有人主張，如果納入電子媒體和網路的文字，目前正值最多人閱讀文字的時代。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　更何況目前的教育也有安排讀書時間。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這麼說來，小學和國中有所謂的讀書時間嘛，雖然只有十分鐘就是了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「很短吧，那點時間根本看不完。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以當初都借一些能在短時間內看完的書呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學雖然會看雜誌，卻不怎麼看小說。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我倒是會就這樣看下去就是了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就這樣看下去？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學顯得很疑惑。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「字面上的意思嘍，因為很在意接下來的發展嘛。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「……咦？該不會，你連上課時間也拿來看書？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我有些尷尬地點點頭。正看到事件發生，偵探開始解謎時，卻說什麼後續要等明天的讀書時間，我怎麼可能等到那個時候？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我把教科書攤在桌上，把書放在抽屜裡像這樣打開……找機會看。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我假裝學校的桌子就在面前，試著重現當時的情景。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學傻眼地張大嘴。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「真虧老師沒生氣呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「上課時，課外書看得特別快喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聊著這些的同時，我們也沒忘記注意畫面上的經濟新聞。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　新聞大致播報完之後，節目開始介紹最新技術帶來的新產品。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　今天的主題是語音辨識虛擬助手Ａｐｐ，智慧型手機也會有的那個。用語音下達命令後就會啟動Ａｐｐ，甚至幫忙建立待辦清單，還可以當成小型備忘錄。似乎是那個的最新版。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　備忘錄功能啊……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「綾瀨同學寫過日記嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我突然想起和丸的對話，因此試著問問看，綾瀨同學卻慌張地「咦」了一聲，顯得有些狼狽。有這麼值得驚訝嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「你……你是說日記？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就是每天寫的那個日記。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　呃，不是每天寫就不叫日記了吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊、喔……嗯，有寫過喔，不過現在沒寫了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔？啊，也就是以前有？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒錯沒錯，以前……嗯，以前。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「真了不起。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「要是換成我，敢說自己撐不過三天。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊……嗯，是啊，很多人沒辦法持續寫日記。至於我呢……嗯，算是持續相當久。但是為什麼突然問這個？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　於是我簡單提了一下和丸在午休時間的對話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　自己正在重新思考要走怎樣的路。丸要我試著將想法化為文字，這樣似乎可以整理思緒，有助於客觀審視自己。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「因此我想知道實際上到底效果如何？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到我的問題，綾瀨同學放下筷子，想了一會兒。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然後十分慎重地緩緩開口：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這個嘛……確實，或許能比較客觀地看待自己的想法。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「也就是對妳有效嘍。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我這麼說完後，綾瀨同學不知為何顯得有些害羞。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是啊。不過正因為太客觀，有時會很不好意思，甚至想抱頭大叫『我到底在想什麼啊』就是了……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我有點驚訝。在他人眼裡，綾瀨同學十分冷靜。雖然我倒不會認為她只有冷靜的一面，卻仍無法想像她回顧日記後抱頭大叫的模樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔，原來妳也會這樣啊？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　感到很意外的我這麼表示，結果她在我面前連連揮手說：「剛剛的不算。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我感到很疑惑，然而綾瀨同學並未多做解釋。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「把剛剛那些忘掉。沒什麼大不了的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這麼說完後，她硬是把話題轉回新聞節目上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　唉，畢竟日記的內容都是些私事嘛。就算在意，也不能追究。我也配合她，將目光轉向電視。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　念完書準備躺上床時，我突然想起一件事。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我翻開筆記本。一回顧起那些上課時從腦袋裡冒出來的字句，那種坐立難安的感覺又回來了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒辦法靠自己找出自己想做的事，也是個問題啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　只是簡單地把想法做個紀錄就能看出這點也很恐怖。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　感覺就像自己的丟臉之處被再三強調一樣。原來如此，看自己寫的東西會想抱頭大叫就是這個意思嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　真虧大家能寫下日記這種東西流傳後世。土佐日記、蜻蛉日記、紫式部日記、更級日記……這些日記被視為文學史上的名作，不曉得它們的作者當年是否想像得到這些文字會被數百年後的子孫們看見，甚至加上感想。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「如果知道，他們會有什麼感覺呢？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　抱頭大叫嗎？還是說「請請請，多看一點」呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　呃，思緒飄太遠了。所以說，必須認真思考自己想做的事才行……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我拿起手機，搜尋有關志願大學的種種資料。儘管可能太晚了，但總比什麼都不做來得好吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看來這個週末的三天連假，很多學校都安排了校園開放日。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　正好18日是慶陵，19日是早稻穗，20日是一之瀨大學。大考之前只剩下這次機會了，更重要的是月底有三方面談。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「校園開放日就去看看吧……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　希望到時候能抓到些許方向。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　把預定行程輸入手機的行事曆之後，我這才上床睡覺。</span></span><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　　　<b>９月15日（星期三）　綾瀨沙季</b><br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　宣告午休到來的鐘聲響了，我抱著便當站起身。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然後告訴坐在旁邊的班長：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「今天我另外有約。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著，我拿起手裡的便當盒，在她面前晃了晃，意思是「所以沒辦法和妳們一起吃飯」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔？啊，『休息室』？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我點點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「抱歉。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒關係、沒關係，反正我們也沒有約定嘛。喂～小涼，妳今天的午餐打算怎麼解決呀？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「今天我在想要不要去餐廳。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔，不是便當日啊？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「媽媽感冒了，所以今天放學後我也要早點回去，必須做飯才行。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「唉呀呀，真是糟糕。那我也一起去吧。所以說，我們要去餐廳嘍，沙季小姐。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，嗯，我知道了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　沙季小姐……昨天是「沙沙」，更之前是「沙季季」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不知道為什麼，班長對我的稱呼一直不固定。與其說是故意的，不如說是不太在意吧？感覺要看她當時的心情。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　也向小涼──佐藤涼子同學道歉後，我走出教室，往圖書室的方向移動。倒不是要借書，因為目的地就在通往特別棟的走道之前。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這個位於圖書室前的方形空間，擺了幾張桌椅供學生自習、看書、吃飯，只要有空位就可以自由使用。正式名稱我不知道，學生都叫它「休息室」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和真綾約在這個「休息室」碰面。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　走著走著，我突然發現一件事。仔細一想，一年半以前我都還不會和班上同學一起吃飯，所以也不會說出「抱歉沒辦法一起吃飯」這種話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　真的不一樣了呢。我和她們一起吃午飯的頻率，現在已經高到不解釋一句就會過意不去的地步。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　走向「休息室」的途中，我都在思考這些事。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「抱歉，等很久了嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「剛到喔～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　心想「就算等了很久，妳還是會這麼說」的我，把便當放到真綾旁邊的座位上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我想要飲料，於是從角落的自動販賣機買了瓶裝茶，這才坐到她旁邊──採光良好的窗邊座位。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　久違地和真綾一起吃午飯。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　坐下後，我看向真綾手邊，有些疑惑。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那是買來的便當，看上去是從便利商店或合作社買的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「便當嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒錯是也。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是也……呃，二年級的時候妳不是都吃麵包嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不愧是沙季，明明不怎麼關心別人，卻看得很仔細呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這是讚美？還是諷刺？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「讚美啦讚美。我只是在想，即使沒有一起吃飯，沙季對這種細節也觀察得很仔細呢，像是隨身攜帶的小東西和穿著等。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我自己不太清楚，但既然真綾這麼說，應該就是了吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　確實……我雖然不太關心別人，卻不代表完全不在意。古人有云：「知己知彼，百戰不殆」嘛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　而且，我會下意識地觀察別人的穿搭，這點我有自覺。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我這麼說之後，真綾點點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沙季的觀察力很強喔～妳會習慣性檢查對方的隨身物品和特殊能力吧？這是冒險的基本原則。中毒就要用解毒藥，麻痺就要用狀態異常回復藥。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　真綾邊說邊撕開便當外面的塑膠膜。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　但我覺得好像哪裡不對勁。話說回來，那個狀態異常什麼的是怎樣？又是在講電玩遊戲吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我納悶地看向真綾撕開的便當外包裝──上面寫著味噌豬排便當，還有（大碗）的字樣，分量相當多。這麼嬌小的身軀到底要怎麼裝進這些東西啊？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「吃得完嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「當然！然後，對於剛才那句『不是麵包嗎』的回答，第二節課是體育吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我點點頭。我們是隔壁班，體育課會一起上。而真綾就是在那個時候找我一起吃午飯的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「因為肚子餓啦～我在上學前就買好麵包了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「該不會……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「正解！我提前吃掉啦！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她舉起手伸向天花板。不過先等一下……換句話說，真綾本來午餐要和平常一樣吃麵包，但因為肚子餓了提前把麵包吃掉，才會另外買便當？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「……真綾，妳是男生嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　偶爾會看到男生提前吃便當。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「真沒禮貌。人家可是羞花閉月的少女喔～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「難以置信。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「上午有體育課時，就算要提前吃便當也在所不惜！而且今天是馬拉松吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這個嘛……確實跑了很長一段距離啦。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「肚子餓時管它的，吃就對了！出自『必勝！考試會出的高中女生常識』！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　……是嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　懷疑起真綾那些常識的我，打開自己的便當。只是個把早上剩菜隨便裝一下的普通便當──煎鮭魚、海苔、白飯、剩下的煎蛋捲、少許羊栖菜，姑且算是有控制熱量。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說完「開動」之後，我們便吃起午飯。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「話又說回來啊～總覺得沙季離我愈來愈遠了耶～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「會嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　升上三年級之後，我經常和佐藤同學、班長待在一起，確實很久沒像這樣和真綾閒聊。不過每週都會在體育課遇上好幾次，選修課也常碰面，我倒是不覺得距離感有什麼變化。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「找妳一起去夏祭也被拒絕了～哭哭～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　驚。原、原來是這個啊。雖然知道她根本沒流淚，只是假哭，但我對於煙火大會的事依舊有點心虛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那個啊……唉呀，剛好有點……嗯。抱歉。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我含糊其詞，真綾卻突然抬起頭。為什麼滿臉笑容？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊！該不會妳和別人一起去了？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？啊，不──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「淺村同學對吧！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「太、太大聲了啦……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我把手指放在嘴巴前面，「噓！」地要她安靜。直覺太敏銳了。還有，妳為什麼要用那種小狗一般的眼神看著我啊？這麼感興趣嗎？應該是吧。換作是以前的我會蒙混過去，不過真綾早就知道了嘛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「呃，嗯，是啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「哇喔～！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「噓──！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那什麼怪聲啊……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「……禁止會讓人害羞的台詞。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「連害羞都這麼可愛耶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不理妳了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我好不容易才恢復正經嚴肅的表情，繼續吃便當。再多做什麼反應也只會讓真綾高興而已。然而，手裡的筷子猛地停了下來。我陷入沉思。這麼說來……最近我似乎從許多方面來說都沒辦法客觀審視自己了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我看向窗戶另一邊。可能因為還是九月中吧，風景和夏天時沒什麼不同。樹葉依舊是綠的，草地也維持漂亮的顏色。不過灑落的陽光確實比盛夏來得溫和，天空也不再是夏季的色彩。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　季節不知不覺間緩緩流轉。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　要明確知曉究竟是在哪一天由夏季變為秋季，十分困難。變化一點點地造訪，人類無法知覺昨天和今天的差異，卻會在某天突然發現──啊，已經是秋天了呢。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我偷偷瞄向滿面笑容看著我的真綾。在她眼裡，如今的我好像很呆。問題在於我自己對此一無所覺。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不僅如此，我甚至不曉得自己如今看起來是什麼樣子。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　以前不會這樣。自己在別人眼裡是什麼模樣？至少我隨時都會注意、理解自己看起來是什麼模樣──我是這麼想的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我的焦點從窗外風景轉為窗戶的玻璃。玻璃上淺淺地映出我自己的臉，那張已經見慣的臉。亮色系的頭髮差不多已經長回以前的長度，該修剪一下讓髮尾整齊。耳上戴著小小的圓形耳環。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我想當個能夠獨自生存又充滿魅力的女性，像媽媽那樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　想研究時尚，也想兼顧學業。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我常照鏡子檢查自己的外表。嗯，畢竟我是女生，這樣應該很正常。雖然好像有部分學生說我是個迎合男生的玩咖，但是我不在意，那些人和我毫無交集。我認為這種打扮也是我心目中那個「完美綾瀨沙季」的一部分，不覺得自我分析的結果與外人眼裡的形象有什麼差異。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　最近這部分變得有些曖昧不明。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不知是出於和淺村同學的關係穩定下來的安全感或其他理由，我覺得現在完全無法控制自己在別人眼裡的形象。為什麼？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「居然被真綾說呆……挺傷人的耶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喂，沙季，不要單方面嫌我呆，咱們一起踏上呆子之路吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不要。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦～哭哭～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　邊吃午飯邊聊著些無謂的事，一同歡笑──覺得這樣也不錯、很愜意的自己，也讓人有些迷惘。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我好像搞不懂現在的「綾瀨沙季」了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　和淺村同學一起打工歸來，吃晚飯時──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們有些在意讀賣前輩談到的經濟新聞，因此難得地在起居室邊看電視邊吃。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　播報完當日新聞，節目介紹起似乎很受歡迎的新產品時，淺村同學突然開口。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「綾瀨同學寫過日記嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我不小心吞了塊咬到一半的馬鈴薯，結果差點噎住，於是硬把它嚥下去。好難受。馬鈴薯總算從食道掉進胃裡……呼。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「你……你是說日記？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我勉強擠出這個問句。他有沒有發現我的動搖啊？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就是每天寫的那個日記。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　淺村同學似乎沒放在心上。不是天天寫還叫做「日記」嗎？至於其他聽起來像「日記」的……啊，嗯，以樟科樹木當原料的辛香料（註：日語中，日本肉桂發音近似於日記），那個也是。嗯，應該不是那個吧，我知道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊、喔……嗯，有寫過喔，不過現在沒寫了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔？啊，也就是以前有？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒錯沒錯，以前……嗯，以前。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然已經是一年前了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我想起已經封印的日記，還在書桌抽屜裡。那本日記裡，清楚地記下了我和淺村同學成為一家人之後，逐漸受到他吸引的經過。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　回頭閱讀日記時的心情一口氣在心中重現，我明白自己的心跳已在不知不覺間愈來愈快。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　淺村同學並未注意到我的動搖，只表示他從丸同學那邊聽說日記有客觀審視自己的效果。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這個嘛……確實，或許能比較客觀地看待自己的想法。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我勉強擠出這句話，儘管實情有些不一樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不只是腦袋裡的想法，就連心情也會重現──我對此深有體會。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是啊。不過正因為太客觀，有時會很不好意思，甚至想抱頭大叫『我到底在想什麼啊』就是了……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　淺村同學一臉意外的表情。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不過，實際上就是這樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不止思緒，還能這麼明確地回想起自己當時的心情，或許是因為曾以「日記」這種形式吐露過吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　自覺……自覺啊。確實，我對自己的心意有所自覺，好像也是透過日記。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　為了避免淺村同學發現我的動搖，後面的對話我隨便蒙混過去了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　收拾完畢後，我先去洗澡。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我在一個人泡澡的同時試著想了一下。難道我的客觀審視能力變差（用真綾的說法就是變呆了），是因為不再寫日記了……嗎……？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「可是啊……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我一邊拍打水面，一邊思索。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　事到如今，重拾日記好像也沒什麼用。</span></span><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　於是我又想起抽屜裡那本日記的內容，想起寫日記時的紛亂心情，感覺自己的分身在腦袋裡害羞到「啊啊啊啊」地打滾。<br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我為什麼會在日記裡寫下「嫉妒」這種話呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　要是被人家拿去看，我絕對會不顧他人目光大鬧一場，我有自信。事到如今還能重拾這種引發危險行為的因子嗎？我想客觀審視自己，想要檢討自己。可是想歸想──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「日記啊……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><br><img loading="lazy" src="https://res.lightnovel.fun/images/260521/57257872a1ab24dd1c036ade97767122.jpg?m=NIjPbHmVwyGhYsFhvCqWaQ&amp;t=1781007686" img-width="1384" img-height="2048" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;"><br><span style="color: #000000">　　低語沉進晃蕩的水面，落入胸間的溝壑。</span><br><br><span style="color: #000000">　　伴隨著嘆息。</span></span></span><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　　<b>　９月20日（星期一．假日）　淺村悠太</b><br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　從新宿車站搭快速列車往西約四十分鐘。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　走出車站南口，眼前是個只有一條車道的小圓環。朝左右望去，高樓不多，天空比想像中還要寬廣。步道與車道之間種了整排的綠色行道樹，能夠讓眼睛休息。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　繞過這一段，來到車站往南延伸的四線道。我走在步道上，體會著右手邊雜木林的壓迫感與草地的氣息。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　前方稍遠處突然沒了樹木，似乎是通往校內的入口。我看向手機，上面同樣寫著那是通往一之瀨大學國立校區的門。也就是說大學校園近在咫尺。仔細一看，的確擺出了校園開放日的導覽看板。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在櫃台辦好手續後，我領了小冊子和校內導覽圖，踏入一之瀨大學。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　其實我有點焦慮。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　前天、昨天，我分別去了慶陵和早稻穗的校園開放日。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　但總覺得不太對勁，我沒辦法想像自己進那兩所大學就讀的模樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在這種情況下，三天連假的最後一天，我來到這所一之瀨大學。如果參觀過這裡後同樣心無所感，就表示列入候選的三所大學都無法讓我動心。這樣會令人很不安。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這個嘛，如果有人要用「兩、三個小時的校園參觀，根本不能了解什麼」來質疑我，倒也沒說錯。何況對於整個學校、社團介紹的氣氛等，參觀者往往只會有覺得「好厲害」、「好成熟」之類的感想。即使如此，參觀依然有其意義。「大學」這個教學之處，在我心中的形象更加具體了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然而，卻少了「就是這裡！」的臨門一腳──雖然對於各一流大學來說，這種想法未免太過狂妄。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　有點偏題了。我參加校園開放日，目的不止在於決定志願校，更在於想擺脫不知自己要做什麼的狀態。我來這裡，是想要得到對於將來的提示。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　自己想花費四年學些什麼？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在上課中將自身思緒言語化時我也想過，我看書的理由，雖然有部分是為了模擬體驗，不過接觸新思維似乎更加重要。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「你們還有話要聊吧？沒關係，坐著聊就好，我來泡。淺村同學，你要嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我看向眼前的杯子。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　茶色液體還剩下一半以上。老實說，突然就要我坐在遠比自己年長的副教授和教授面前，即使身為一個咖啡愛好者，也只敢潤潤喉而已。話說回來，這樣讓人家請客真的好嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不、不用了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我這麼回答後，森教授站起身來，走向自動販賣機。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　工藤老師看著恩師的背影，表情有些尷尬。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「糟糕，我是不是撒嬌過頭啦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她現在看起來就像個惡作劇被抓而挨罵的小孩。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然而工藤老師臉上的尷尬轉瞬間消失無蹤。她轉向我這邊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那麼，關於剛剛的話題……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這人切換得還真快。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「雖然不曉得能不能讓你參考──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　工藤老師開始講起她的經驗。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一之瀨大學綜合人類科學部社會學科。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　滿滿漢字，看起來很難的學部，就是工藤英葉的出身。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說起來──所謂的社會學，究竟是什麼？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　它是一門研究社會的學問。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這個回答很像在打禪機，然而追根究柢之後便是如此。這門學問的主要研究對象是「社會本身」及「社會現象」。社會是怎麼建立的、如何變化、社會現象的真實情況、現象與成因之間的因果關係……找出這些問題的答案，正是社會學的使命──這是工藤老師的開場白。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然不曉得這番話是否正確，但我決定暫且接受這個說法。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「換言之，所謂社會學就是與社會相關的學問，也能說是與人類相關的學問，畢竟社會是由人類聚集而成的。所謂社會現象，說穿了便是個別人類行為累積的結果吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說到這裡，工藤老師停下來喘了口氣，一口氣喝乾剩下的咖啡──但是所剩不多，因此她還用舌頭舔了一下。她依依不捨地看著杯底，繼續說下去：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「每個人類都是基於自由意志而自由地採取行動。但是在社會裡，這些行為會累積為社會現象，叫做『風潮』、『趨勢』之類的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「聽起來很像艾西莫夫的心理史學。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔，居然隨口就說出科幻小說巨擘，真不愧是愛書人。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　得到副教授如此稱讚，讓人不禁想謙虛地回一句「這不算什麼啦」。這邊提到的心理史學，是科幻作家艾西莫夫提出的一門虛構學問。艾西莫夫認為，可以從氣體分子運動類推心理史學──個別氣體分子雖然動作紛亂，但從整團氣體的角度來看，運動會有特定的傾向。同樣地，個別人類的行為雖然無法預測，不過放大到整個社會則會做出特定的行為。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「社會學雖然是從整個社會的角度去追究現象的機制與成因，我卻對它的根源──個別人類的行為與動機更感興趣。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　原來如此，所以才……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「若要追溯源頭，則是因為高中時看了有關『不能看的禁忌』的書。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊……神話的嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　有些神話橋段，無論在哪個文化圈都看得到。而其中有一類，主角因為看見人家說「不可以看」的東西而落得悲慘下場，就叫做「不能看的禁忌」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「高中……所以差不多就是淺村同學現在的年紀。雖然是在那個時候看書得到的知識，卻在大學時回想起來。就這樣，我對於『為什麼被禁止還要看』這樣的心態湧現了興趣。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽她的口吻，好像這是什麼壞事一樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「於是工藤同學帶著我教給她的知識，去了月之宮的研究所。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　把咖啡放到工藤老師面前的森教授，以遺憾的語氣說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我很感謝森老師。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「實在太可惜了。妳在社會學方面可是奇才啊──各種意義上來說都是。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這不是誇獎吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「想要人家誇獎就趕快交出下一篇論文。身為一個研究人員──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「Publish or perish.」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　工藤老師以平板的聲音回應，森教授則是揚起了嘴角。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　Publish or perish──寫論文，否則死。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　還好，在我讀過的漫畫裡出現過這句話。不過我從沒想過會親眼目睹這樣的場景。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　工藤老師嘆了口氣，轉頭對我說：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，於是呢，我畢業後決定進月之宮女子大學的研究所，研究倫理學。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不過，工藤老師至今依舊很感謝在一之瀨大學參加森教授研討會帶給她的寶貴經驗，而且研究陷入瓶頸時，她會跑來找森教授商量。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這番話說明了她出現在這裡的原因，但是「工藤副教授也會碰上瓶頸」這件事更令我驚訝。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以說，我是個人生路在大學轉了大彎的人，而且遠因要追溯到高中。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「原來……如此。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「雖然事後回想起來，即使高中時就以倫理學為目標也不奇怪，不過那個時候時機大概還沒成熟吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到工藤老師這麼說，我陷入沉思。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　時機成熟嗎……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　比方說工作時間。什麼時候工作？工作時間多長？由此造成的生活作息差異也可能導致離婚。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　有沒有照護對象、有沒有和雙親同住、有沒有小孩、吃飯次數、吃飯的內容、社群網路使用時間、娛樂內容、性行為頻率。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　理論上混合了前述種種要素，這些數據有容易蒐集的，也有難以蒐集的。無論如何，重點在於先蒐集這些基礎數據並加以分類，森教授是這麼說的。</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所有科學都始於博物學。蒐集、分類、命名。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　背景是否和法律有關？和新聞有關嗎？和教育有關嗎？和宗教有關嗎？和新技術有關嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　能想到很多種假設。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「男女的薪資落差縮減，使得經濟上對男性的依存度降低，比較不需要擔心所得變少，因此選擇離婚的門檻降低了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「律師事務所自由競爭，使得鼓吹離婚諮商的廣告到處都是，以前因為離婚手續麻煩而猶豫不決的人，也能找到律師了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「工藤同學研究的倫理也不例外。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，是啊。不過比起社會學性質的數據，我覺得了解那些個人因素更有趣。話說回來，社會的倫理觀會隨著時代改變。而人類的行為也會在某種程度上受到社會形成的價值觀左右。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　工藤老師表示，這和什麼「刻意的思考操縱」一類的陰謀論無關，比較類似自然的法則、現象。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　總而言之，一邊蒐集數據一邊尋找關連性，並且深入挖掘之後，就能找到疑似原因的要素。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　而像這樣基於數據剖析社會問題的根源，向政府機關提出建議，也是森教授的職責之一。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「話先說在前頭，就算解決了社會問題，個人的問題也不會跟著消失。即使離婚率降低，依舊不代表自己或身邊其他人就不會離婚。社會學是處理社會現象的學問，無法解決個人問題。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一來我很想知道答案，二來若能從宏觀角度了解人的傾向，將來無論從事哪一行應該都派得上用場吧。</span></span><br><span
