style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　個人的行為在社會上累積後，有可能成為某種傾向──社會現象。社會現象則會回饋到個人身上，對個人行為帶來影響。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　今天聽到的內容，簡單統整之後應該就是這樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說來也是理所當然的，但我從來沒用這種觀點看待「結婚」、「離婚」這些個人性質的事件。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這也能算是我所喜歡的「新觀點」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　有種腦袋裡的線組成了新迴路的感覺。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在那之後，我在一之瀨大學內到處參觀。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然各學部的介紹影片都看過，但可能是自己的視角變了吧，感覺每個學部都比先前來得有意思。我甚至想要以現在的視角重新看一次造訪過的大學。不過嘛，實際上應該抽不出那麼多時間就是了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　至少回頭看看它們的資料吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果看完後，還是覺得這所大學比較吸引我，就以這裡為第一目標──我有了這樣的念頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　也得感謝丸。這三天的校園開放日巡禮，說起來是因為「試著把腦袋裡想的東西寫到紙上作戰」，我才想到要採取行動。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在澀谷站下車時，我隨著剪票口吐出的誇張人潮移動，同時胡思亂想。人潮看似漫無目的隨興移動，但如果從上空俯瞰，大概也能找到規律吧。就像建築物內部要安排好「動線」──讓人與物移動的路線。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　為了吃飯而漫步的人們、快步穿越鬧區要返家的人們、為了遊玩在娛樂設施裡徘徊的人們。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　還有建築物牆上滿滿的數位看板與各色海報。有人無視它們，也有人受到吸引而改變了目的地。攬客聲、引導聲、令人心情亢奮的音樂──這些想透過環境改變個人行為的東西，就是廣告。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　規模小一點的例子，好比書店裡的海報、螢幕展示，都是為了刺激購買欲讓顧客掏錢，換句話說是企圖對個人行為造成影響的手法。而這些產生變化的購買行為，會對今後出書的企畫造成影響。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　自己的行為或許並非純粹出於自由意志，也受到了外在環境影響。一想到這裡就令人有些害怕。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　──這樣啊。說不定我和工藤副教授相反，因為過去一直覺得個人行為屬於個人範圍，才會認為這種論點很新奇，進而對社會現象感興趣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　好奇心有可能成為強烈的動機。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　能不能為將來鋪路先放到一邊，現在的我很想了解這種個人與社會間的交互作用。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我在沉思中走進公寓的正門。直到看見掛在自家門上的淺村家門牌，才總算從思考之海浮出，登上名為現實的島嶼。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　開門的同時，我喊了聲：「我回來了。」廚房傳來回應。我探頭一看，發現老爸正在準備晚餐。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？今天輪到我吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「話是這麼說沒錯，不過我和亞季子去買東西時看到感覺會很好吃的魚。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　仔細一看，細長的魚擺在廚房桌邊準備要烤，塑膠包裝已經拆掉了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「現在正是產季。最近雖然連秋刀魚也很貴，不過今天偶然碰上便宜的。我想你們兩個忙著準備考試，反正區區烤魚我也做得到。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「既然只是烤魚，應該不用費多少工夫。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　最近下廚的頻率也夠讓我講出這種話了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「唉呀，我今天休假，一整天都閒著沒事，不活動一下身體會變遲鈍。沒關係沒關係，悠太也去念書等吃晚飯吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這……雖然求之不得，但這樣好嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我原本怕你只顧念書都沒休息。嗯，看來這一趟有讓你好好調適心情呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　大概是眼尖發現我臉上的問號了吧，老爸接著補充：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「因為你先前看起來找不到目標嘛。既然現在對於缺少了什麼有所自覺，應該比較能有效吸收吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial">　　大考將至，目前生活也算不上困苦，要說可以不用打工的確沒錯。不過這算是我自己的原則。如果能夠考上大學，媽媽他們想必會欣然負擔我和淺村同學的學費，大概還會要我們專注在課業和想做的事情上。我會適度地請他們幫忙，卻沒想過要完全仰賴他們的恩惠。雖然高中生打工的收入實在付不起學費，然而我想表現出「不會只依靠父母支援」的態度。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　發現小園同學面前的結帳隊伍裡有個抱了五六本書的顧客後，我悄悄地用眼神和她交流。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒事吧？要吃餅乾嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，嗯。呃，真要說起來那是我做的……啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我抬頭看向小園同學之後，目光又落回手邊，但在這短短時間內，我的留言已經有了回應。好快！而且回我的是梅莉莎。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳不吃嗎？那我吃掉嘍。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？可以嗎？我真的要吃掉嘍？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　小園同學好像講了些什麼，但是現在沒空理她。我趕緊看梅莉莎的回覆。看來她有發現Saki是我。哇，好久不見，近來可好──寫著類似這樣的話語。在公開的留言欄實在不適合講得太細，所以她說想用簡訊聯絡。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我並不排斥這麼做，於是照她說的確認頻道概要欄，找到了聯絡方式。傳訊息過去後，我們便交換了兩邊都有使用的傳訊Ａｐｐ的ＩＤ，總算透過訊息往來約好接下來的見面。我再次抬起頭，此時餅乾已經只剩最後一塊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　小園同學說是特地留給我的，不過露出那種連最後一塊也想吃的表情講這種話，實在是……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在我正準備問她要不要吃的時候，有人敲了辦公室的門。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　店長跑來喊我們，說是顧客差不多又要蜂湧而來了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我這就過去。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在我回答的同時，小園同學也應了一聲：「我知道了～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這個要怎麼辦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她指著剩下的最後一片。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「吃了吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我從塑膠袋裡拿出最後一片餅乾，塞進嘴裡吃掉。用剩餘的茶把嘴裡餅乾屑沖下去之後，保險起見，我又從口袋裡掏出薄荷錠咬碎，清除餅乾的甜香。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　小園同學搶走我喝完的紙杯，和她自己的一起丟進垃圾桶。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這個能順便幫忙丟嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我把內容物清空的袋子揉成一團，交給桌子對面的小園同學，她接過後一併丟進垃圾桶。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「謝謝。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我先出去嘍。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，去吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　整理完身上的圍裙和名牌，我也回到店裡。離下班還有一小時。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　收工之後就能去見梅莉莎。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「辛苦了。那麼，我先走一步。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說完這句話，小園同學快步走出更衣室。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她沒再對我多說些什麼，剛開始打工時那副容易親近的模樣，彷彿都藏起來了……不，不對。她面對店長、讀賣前輩、淺村同學還是一樣乖，只有和我相處是那副德行。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我想，小園同學就和她自己說的一樣，認為「把原本的自己暴露在他人面前會被討厭」，所以才表現得乖巧。反過來說，原本的她其實沒那麼和善……那副冷淡模樣才是她的本色吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　儘管如此，卻奇妙地不會令人覺得討厭。不僅如此，我甚至感到有點懷念。啊，原來如此。因為和高一的我很像。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　打開辦公室的門要離開時，說了「先走一步」轉過頭去的小園同學秀髮飛揚，內層染的顏色映入眼裡──不認為黑髮的自己是自己而染上的帶紅色彩。意外地好戰、好勝，這大概就是「小園同學的模樣」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我想起真綾的話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　『之前的沙季總是和別人保持距離，講得好聽一點就是冷淡又帥氣的冰山美女。』</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　『妳原本的樣子我也不討厭喔。那樣有那樣的可愛之處。』</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那樣有那樣的好，是嗎……嗯。也對，那樣的小園同學也不壞。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　手機震動，告訴我收到了訊息。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　是梅莉莎傳來的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她通知我已經抵達書店所在大樓前。我連忙換衣服，趕往約好碰面的地點。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　自動門開啟，我走出建築。左右張望後，看見一名金髮褐膚背靠柱子的女性──是梅莉莎。差不多入秋了，但大概是覺得還很熱吧，她穿著裸露程度偏高的輕便服裝，白色背心配上迷彩短褲，丹寧帽的帽沿稍稍遮住了眼睛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在我走向她的同時，她也注意到我而抬起了頭。她面露笑容，舉手招呼。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沙季！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「梅莉莎小姐，好久不見。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沙季近來好嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她用日語這麼說道。我笑著點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎是台灣出身的母親與日本人父親生的混血兒，在日本度過學生時代，所以也會說日語。她謙虛地表示講得不太好，但是日常對話講得相當流暢，我覺得算得上是精通了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以，要去哪裡？要在哪邊聊？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　呃……我看著手機的地圖，指出事先選好的咖啡廳位置。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那家店離澀谷站不遠，靠近代官山。從神宮路往南走，過了玉川路再順著櫻坂稍微往下一點。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「有什麼好喝的茶或好吃的甜點嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「倒不是因為這樣。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我告訴梅莉莎，家裡有門禁（如果晚歸要事先聯絡的時間），那家店離我家近，所以能聊得晚一點。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　路也不算複雜，梅莉莎要回車站不難。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她表示聽我的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「而且這家店不會太貴。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　對我來說，這點也很重要。儘管梅莉莎說：「我請妳呀？」但我謝絕了她的好意。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　畢竟是我主動邀的，實在不該讓人家請客。我希望平攤，儘管對方已經出社會而我還是學生。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這間離打工書店約十分鐘路程的咖啡廳，雖然是連鎖店，卻有種讓人能夠安心的氣氛。看似木製的桌椅，在朦朧燈光下排得整整齊齊。這個時間以下午茶來說算遲，以晚餐來說則太早。平常都坐滿了人需要等，今天倒是輕輕鬆鬆就確保了位置。幸好座位間隔夠寬，可以不必在乎其他顧客。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我點了招牌咖啡，梅莉莎則點了冰淇淋汽水。那東西菜單上寫著「超大杯」，沒問題嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「再過一下就是晚餐時間了，必須控制在這點程度才行。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　喝了這麼大一杯還能吃晚飯？這樣啊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我原本以為自己的飯量是「正常範圍」，說不定其實算少。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　又一次重逢的招呼之後，我們便互相報告近況。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎劈頭就說：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以，和妳那個男朋友處得好嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我差點把嘴裡的水噴出來。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一開始就談戀愛話題？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　為何大家這麼關心別人的戀愛啊？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　話雖如此，但梅莉莎給了我很大的幫助，不老實告訴她未免不太公平。<br><br><img loading="lazy" src="https://res.lightnovel.fun/images/260521/4564248a5c2c7a562d82067b5b1a7cb9.jpg?m=n1pVlJTOjPDEUq_deOSs8Q&amp;t=1781007686" img-width="1384" img-height="2048" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;"><br>　　「呃，嗯，很好。」<br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不錯耶！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我有些不好意思地肯定後，發現梅莉莎並不是在調侃我。她恢復正經的表情，微微一笑。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在這方面，她似乎和周圍的人不太一樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳那邊怎樣？居然來日本開演唱會，看來音樂活動很順利。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊～呃，託福？嗯，還行啦。大家對我的歌比預期中更捧場，我很開心。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　仔細一問才知道，她在日本似乎也有歌迷，那些人之中有些說想聽現場演唱。大概是這樣才導致她來日本吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「什麼時候到的？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「昨天！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那幾乎等於剛到嘛。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎點點頭。她說昨天很晚才抵達，還沒怎麼逛東京。話雖如此，但她是來工作不是來觀光，也沒那麼多時間能玩。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「久違的日本啊。以觀光客的身分來，就會覺得日本真不錯。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳好像很意外。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　實際上，的確覺得很意外。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我還以為梅莉莎是為了逃離日本生活的壓抑才前往新加坡的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　啊，慢著。她剛剛加上了「以觀光客的身分來」這條但書。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我啊，因為想過自己喜歡的生活，換了居住的國家、換了來往的群體，做了許多許多事。然而，這不代表我討厭日本。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「原來是這樣啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「因為飯很好吃！服務也好！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「服務好？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。現在的日本，對於觀光客來說非常棒喔。我去了很多其他國家，但是這裡最強。尤其是都會啊，電車和公車幾乎不會誤點吧？街上乾淨，很少看見垃圾。即使走進大眾取向的廉價商店，店員也都面帶笑容親切應對。就連百圓商店的店員也笑咪咪有禮貌，感覺很舒服～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著說著，店員端來了我們點的東西。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這是招牌咖啡。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一杯熱咖啡擺到我面前。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這是特大號冰淇淋汽水。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一個有把手的超大杯子「咚」一聲擺到梅莉莎面前。我不由得瞪大眼睛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這家店我之前當然也來過。來過歸來過，但我從沒點過冰淇淋汽水，所以這還是第一次見到。的確，尺寸無愧於特大號之名。容量恐怕有水杯的兩倍以上。冒氣泡的綠色透明液體和上面的冰淇淋看起來很美味。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「兩位點的到齊了嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和梅莉莎同時點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　店員很有禮貌地鞠躬說「請兩位慢慢享用」後離去。梅莉莎看著店員的背影，露出「看吧」的表情說道：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「對不對？很親切吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不過……這不是理所當然的嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「在如今的日本或許是。就連顧客也都不會大聲嚷嚷。電車裡很安靜，街上也很安靜。乾淨、沉穩，面帶笑容、溫和有禮，還會為了滿足顧客需求而親切地應對，讓人很開心。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎拿長柄湯匙挖了一塊汽水上的冰淇淋，送進嘴裡說：「嗯～好吃。」接著又補上一句──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「──以觀光客的角度來看。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我吃了一驚。這是第二次。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎以吸管啜飲冰淇淋汽水。只見綠色液體順著透明吸管上升，消失在那對紅唇的彼方。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「好喝～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她喘了口氣之後，繼續說下去。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「以旅客身分待在這裡時，日本式服務令人開心。我會覺得，既然服務這麼周到，多收點錢也可以。接待顧客時滿面笑容、免費的水要喝幾杯都行、餐點會幫忙端過來，這一杯汽水要價居然只比五百圓再多一點，實在太便宜了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「對於高中生來說，這已經是不小的負擔了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不過，好服務要花錢很正常。我也不想把hospitality當成freeride。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　所謂hospitality就是「招待」，freeride則是「免費乘車」的意思。梅莉莎的言下之意是，她不喜歡接受人家的招待卻不支付酬勞。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳剛剛說了『當旅客的時候』吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　對於我這句話，梅莉莎點點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我好歹也是靠音樂吃飯的，所以說呢，算得上做音樂的人。做音樂的時候要維持『正常』很困難。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「維持正常……很困難？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「受到照顧也沒辦法回報。不僅如此，好意反而會帶來壓力。妳想想看，假如差一點就能想到好樂句時，有人跑來問『碰上什麼麻煩了嗎？』會怎樣？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　儘管試著想像了，不過很遺憾，我對藝術方面的事不太熟，實在沒辦法體會。那麼，試著換成念書。的確，不會希望人家在我集中精神念書時打擾……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「可是，這種時候別人應該不會來吵妳吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　至少我周圍的人不會打擾我念書。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯～我遠比沙季想像的還要不正常。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「……遠比？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。不一樣。我曾在作曲時無論如何都想不出來，因此一星期沒有離開過房間。我拔掉電話線、關掉手機。光照進來會分心，所以我關窗戶、拉窗簾。光亮只有最暗的夜燈。雖然會用事先買好的杯麵充飢，但是連吃完的容器都沒辦法拿出去丟。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒辦法……不是不做。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「靈感要來的時候啊，光是站起身就會讓它消失不見。只要一個聲響便會消失，就連自己發出的聲音也會讓它消失。不管旋律或樂句都一樣，在它到來之間，只能在黑暗裡一動也不動，屏息等待。我的情況是這樣，就類似等待獵物的獵人。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　用獵人當例子，感覺很符合梅莉莎的風格。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「然後好不容易才會有個像鬼火的小傢伙來到黑暗之中。不過它就像個非常微小的泡泡，而且只肯停留一下下。等到覺得差不多了，準備靠過去抓住它，在這一刻，會連呼吸都不願意。要躡手躡腳、逐步接近，等它來到眼前時猛然伸手！必須在它消失之前抓住才行。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「原來……是這樣嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我沒辦法說自己能夠明白。這時的我，要想像創作者著手創造的那一瞬間究竟有多纖細，實在太過困難。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　此時不知道為什麼，我腦中浮現了不在乎他人目光躺在研究室地板上，還堅稱自己是在思索的工藤副教授。這麼說來，第一次遇到那個人時，她好像也因為躺在草地上而挨罵。那個時候，她恐怕也是躺著思索吧。她看起來就是個一旦聚精會神，便會覺得其他事物都無所謂的人。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「進行音樂創作時的我非常任性。我從小就是這樣，雖然還很小的時候對象並不是音樂。小學低年級的時候，有一次家裡的水龍頭壞掉──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　原本以為話題突然偏了……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「──導致水從水龍頭滴個沒完沒了。水滴不斷落到下方的水槽裡，發出充滿韻律的噹噹聲。偶爾也會有些水滴一口氣落下，發出另一種『噠噠噹！』的聲音。我覺得很有意思，一直聽下去也不會膩，就算家人喊我吃飯也不動，告訴我該去上學了也不動。我一直聽一直聽，無奈的父親最後硬是把我拉走，然後丟進車裡帶到學校去。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這還真是……厲害。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那天的課我完全聽不進去，水滴的鼓聲始終在腦袋裡迴盪著。好不容易放學回家時，水龍頭已經修好，水不再滴了。我當時還哭了喔～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　居然對區區漏水聲這麼執著……再怎麼說都算得上很稀奇吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不過我並不認為自己這樣是好事，因為我知道這會讓身邊人為我操心，自己卻給不了半點回報。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　啊，原來如此。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我總算有點明白了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「無法回報的關懷，會帶給梅莉莎小姐壓力。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我這麼一說，那張因為喝冰淇淋汽水而顯得愉快的臉上，一時沒了表情。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊…………」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我說錯了嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒說錯。我之所以想找個會適度放著自己不管的地方，應該也有部分理由在於這裡。沒有『放棄音樂』這個選項，因為這等於要我放棄活下去。不過，如果我想要活得像自己，待在日本就會承受太多單方面的關懷。這樣不公平，整天面對無法回報的關懷會持續帶給我壓力……嗯，我想，應該就是沙季說的這樣。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎雖然感覺自由奔放，卻不會給人任性的印象，大概就是因為有這種追求公平的精神吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「只接受人家的款待，自己卻什麼都不付出，這樣不公平。所以，我只能以旅客身分待在這個國家。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如此達觀的梅莉莎，在我看起來好成熟。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以妳才去了新加坡。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就是這樣……不過──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎有些欲言又止，一副有話想說的模樣看著我的眼睛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她閉上了嘴。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然後突然轉變話題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「欸，那沙季這邊，最近有什麼不一樣的地方嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　即使是不擅長洞悉人心的我，也感覺話題轉得太硬了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　亦即「這個話題到此為止」的意思。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽完問題，我稍微想了一下。有什麼不一樣嗎？對了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　略高的舞台前方安排了觀眾的座位，更後方則像觀景台那樣高出一截。那裡就是公關席，椅子擺得整整齊齊。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然並非能讓人感覺和現場融為一體的鄰近表演者座位，但是要專心聽音樂或許這邊更好。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　觀眾席已經坐了不少人。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　主要客群的年紀看來比我們這樣的高中生還要稍微大一點，大多二十來歲。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　男生和女生的人數應該差不多。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然沒到全滿，但進場的客人應該約有七成。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這場表演和以前丸讓我看的搖滾樂團、偶像團體演唱會錄影不一樣，似乎是以聽歌為主的歌手演唱會，所以大家不是站著，而是坐在椅子上安穩地聽。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學在公關席正中央略靠前（不知為何大家從後面開始坐，我們也是不得已）的位置坐下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　坐下之後，我們兩個像鄉巴佬一樣東張西望，綾瀨同學卻在回頭看向入口那邊時停下動作。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她結凍似的盯著某一點看。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我也順著她的視線看過去。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　入場的門旁邊，貼了一張很大的海報。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那是熱帶的……叢林吧？南美……不，多半是亞洲。在巨大的葉片與糾結的藤蔓之中，隱隱可見長滿青苔的石造建築。大概是古代遺跡還什麼吧。梅莉莎的胸上照，大膽地合成到了這片綠色風景之上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　應該是合成的吧？難道還為了拍這張照片特地跑去叢林？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　亞洲熱帶雨林成為背景，海報中的梅莉莎側著身體，唯有眼睛看向海報之外。被風吹動的零星髮絲遮住了眼角。嘴邊雖然帶著笑意，秀髮之下隱約可見的犀利目光，卻讓她宛如密林裡盯上獵物的野獸。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那個真不錯耶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學輕聲說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　海報裡，一句英文以凌亂的書寫體蓋在梅莉莎的頭髮上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「上面寫著什麼啊？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不是『梅莉莎』嗎？雖然字體潦草不容易辨識，不過最左邊應該是Ｍ吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽她這麼一說，我總算能解讀寫在上面的字母。原來如此，好像勉強可以讀出梅莉莎．吳。啊，下面有比較小的印刷體寫著相同內容。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　此時我靈光一閃，看向腿上的小冊子。工作人員在入口給我們的，亮出公關票後沒付錢就領到了，這東西原本應該包含在票錢之內吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「和這個一樣。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　小冊子封面和那張海報一模一樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學也注意到小冊子封面就是海報，於是拿起來翻閱。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，裡面也很棒。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然只有寥寥幾頁，但裡面有今天的曲順、梅莉莎寫的介紹文、樂團成員等表演者的介紹，後面則成了梅莉莎的寫真集。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　內容要看了才知道，但是像照片的擺法、文章的位置等都精心設計過，而且易於閱讀。身為設計書店海報的打工人員，應該好好學習人家的優秀品味。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　話雖如此，但實在是──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「水準這麼高，我做不到啊……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　可能是聽到我的嘀咕了吧，綾瀨同學問道：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這種東西不是都交給專家來做嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我想應該是。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「感覺既時髦又瀟灑，好棒喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們原以為已經把音量壓低到只有彼此聽得見，所以從正後方傳來「謝謝」的時候大吃一驚。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在我們後方的座位，一位看上去二十五左右的女性翹著腳坐在那裡。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看見我和綾瀨同學同時回頭，她露出微笑。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那個……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「聽到你們對小冊子和海報的讚美，我很高興喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學不由得拿起小冊子和她比較。呃，再怎麼比較，應該還是看不出來吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「呃……？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「做出那個的，就是我。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　做了藍色挑染的狼尾頭女性笑得相當開心，又細又大的耳環跟著搖晃，修長的眉毛彎成了弓形。此時此刻，她的五官感覺十分柔和，原先那種冰山美人的氛圍消失得無影無蹤。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她以右手理了一下短髮後搔搔頭，對我們露出淘氣的笑容。右眼下方的淚痣，帶來了屬於年長女性的豔麗。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　目光與她相對時，我的視線會略微偏上，因此她肯定很高。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　肩膀以女性來說也顯得較寬，再搭配那一身西裝，若沒看見胸前的隆起，說不定會以為她是個偏瘦的男性。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「初次見面，對吧？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，是的。呃……幸會。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那個……妳是──啊，幸會。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學戰戰兢兢地輪流向對方打招呼。而女性並未錯過綾瀨同學那短暫的遲疑，指著自己露出胸有成竹的開朗笑容。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「秋廣瑠佳。瑠璃的瑠、佳人的佳。叫我瑠佳就行了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「美麗的藍色，是嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔？很有學問呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著，她微微一笑。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學看向我。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「瑠璃是？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「寶石的名字嘍。瑠璃是日本名，其實指的就是青金石。不過也有人用它來指稱金綠石，或是更為普遍的藍色寶石。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「青金石和金綠石都是美麗的寶石，『佳人』也是指美人。無論哪一個字，都具備『美』的意思。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我這麼解釋之後，瑠佳小姐露出有些不好意思的表情說道：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這是雙親的心願，他們希望我能夠像瑠璃一樣美麗。不過很遺憾，如果要用『佳人』來稱呼，我稍嫌粗野了點。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不不不，我認為完全配得上「美人」……或者該說「美形」這個詞。咦？該不會頭髮弄藍色挑染就是用來代替名片吧？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以，你們是？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我叫淺村悠太。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我是綾瀨沙季。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　報上姓名後，瑠佳小姐便伸出手來，我們於是順勢這麼和她握了手。瑠佳小姐伸出的手上戴著銀色戒指，手腕上還有好幾個細手環。握手時，手環順著手臂的動作上下躍動，更在天花板燈光的照耀下閃閃發光。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　自我介紹完畢，綾瀨同學略顯急切地問：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那個……妳剛剛說……是妳做的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就和字面上一樣。這個是我做的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳的工作是製作這些東西嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，是啊。我姑且算是個設計師，雖然還是新人。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「設計師……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學目光在小冊子和瑠佳小姐身上來回，同時輕聲嘀咕。換句話說，她就是剛剛綾瀨同學講的「製作小冊子的專家」……應該吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「設計師這一行，工作內容原來還包含這個啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯？唔～淺村同學，對嗎？你認為設計師是一份怎樣的工作？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到她這麼問，我翻找起腦袋裡的情報。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「做衣服的人？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那是服裝設計師。雖然嚴格說來，設計師並沒有實際製作衣服就是了，負責製作的另有其人。設計師呢，就是以設計為業的人。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「設計……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　好像懂了，又好像不太懂。對方的意思好像是「設計就是這麼一回事喔」，但若要確定到底是怎麼一回事，卻又突然變得曖昧起來。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這世上的一切產品，都有它需要的功能與特性。研究這些功能與特性並思考該怎麼滿足條件，就是設計嘍。所以，你們可以當成凡是生產現場都會有設計師在。而我，則包下了設計活動空間、看板、標誌、小冊子的設計工作。因為還是新人，這份工作是朋友幫忙介紹的。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　瑠佳小姐這番話，勾起了綾瀨同學的好奇心。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳說的朋友，該不會……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「梅莉莎是我的老朋友。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我吃了一驚。綾瀨同學則是一臉能夠理解的表情。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「既然坐在這裡，代表你們也是吧？雖然看起來像高中生。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們同時點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沒想到她的朋友裡還有日本的高中生，甚至招待你們來這裡。真是稀奇。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是這樣嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「因為她是個看起來爽朗，卻很難相處的人。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「很難相處……嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看見表情一本正經的綾瀨同學歪頭表示疑惑，瑠佳小姐笑了出來。當然，她有考慮到周圍的人，並未笑出聲。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「哈哈哈……小妹妹……不，沙季應該沒見過她那副德行。原來如此原來如此，看來她很欣賞妳呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是……這樣嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學似乎陷入沉思。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　低頭思考一會兒後，她露出下定了什麼決心的表情抬起頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學「那個……」想要找瑠佳小姐談話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然而這時正好有看似演唱會工作人員的人來找瑠佳小姐。她站起身，回了對方一句「好好好」便離開了。心想這人真是爽快的我，回頭看見綾瀨同學遺憾的表情。看起來綾瀨同學還想多聊一下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們等了瑠佳小姐一會兒，但是演唱會好像要開始了，因此不得不轉向前方。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　和電影開始前一樣，播放完各種提醒（像是不要錄影、關掉手機等）之後，舞台隨即轉暗。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　演唱會開始了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　整場演唱會約兩小時。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　中間沒什麼談話，是一場以聽歌為主的舞台表演。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　沒什麼華麗的麥克風演出，主要是以前聽過的民謠和搖滾樂，大多是那種能直入人心的歌曲。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不過，即使沒有什麼吶喊、帶動唱，蘊含梅莉莎感情的歌聲仍舊緊緊抓住了聽眾的心，令人不由得身陷其中，甚至令我覺得自己的體溫可能提高了零點二度左右。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　旁邊的綾瀨同學應該也一樣。我不時會偷瞄她的側臉，發現她著魔似的看著舞台，臉頰泛紅、眼神迷濛，在歌曲和歌曲之間的空檔，還會發出心滿意足的嘆息。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　格外引起我注意的，則是一股偶爾掠過我鼻尖的香氣，應該來自她身上。大概是香水還什麼吧。所謂的香水，是藉由體溫加熱之後揮發為香氣……說不定，歌曲也帶動了她的熱情。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一直盯著她有可能被發現，於是我準備把目光挪回台上。就在這一刻，她為了鼓掌而抬起的手，和我的手相碰。我連忙把手縮回。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「抱……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我準備道歉，但她一直看著舞台上的梅莉莎，好像連我們的手相碰都沒發現。至於我，在手和手相碰的時候，不知為什麼心臟跳得比平常更快。此時此刻，我甚至忘了要好好聽演唱會，連梅莉莎的聲音都聽不到。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　要克制狂跳的心臟實在很難。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　之後我把注意力轉回舞台，兩小時轉眼間就過去了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　要求安可的掌聲響起。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　順應眾意從舞台側面重新登場的梅莉莎，唱了可說是今天唯一一首的抒情歌。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然整首都是英語，不過很難得地我知道這首歌，所以大概能理解歌詞。而且它用的英語也不怎麼難。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這首不是原創樂曲，而是知名的爵士樂。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我偷偷打量坐在旁邊的綾瀨同學，看見她眼角隱隱有淚光。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎的演唱會，隨著盛大的掌聲落幕。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　燈亮了起來，夢幻時光走到盡頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　告知散場的廣播響起，觀眾紛紛從進來的門離開。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我隨興地觀察了一下眾人離去時的表情，應該很多人感到心滿意足。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　幾個看似工作人員的人來到我們這一區，表示稍後梅莉莎會來打招呼。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學互看了一眼，拿出手機確認時間。最後決定，既然她馬上過來，那就至少留下來打聲招呼。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　數分鐘後，只在表演服上披件外套的梅莉莎來了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「謝謝你們來～！我愛大家！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她依序用日、英、中這麼說，同時向我們揮手。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一些看似音樂業界的人立刻上前搭話，另外還有人親手將小花束遞給她。這麼說起來，入口處好像有個箱子放一般聽眾送的禮物。看見這一幕，綾瀨同學覺得自己好像也該送點什麼。她說，就算沒辦法親手遞給梅莉莎，也可以寫個卡片祝賀一下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　此時我才發現，公關席的人好像排起了隊。據說是因為梅莉莎會在離開之前和我們握手。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　由於慢了一步，加上不好意思和人家搶，所以我們排在最後面，結果前面正好是瑠佳小姐。剛剛沒注意到，她好像在開演前就坐到公關席的某處了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　舞台上已開始收拾善後，像是回收譜架、收拾臨時擺出來的椅子，以及撕下海報。由於人家在忙，所以隊伍末端縮到角落避免礙事。可能因為剩下來的都是朋友吧，梅莉莎不只握手，還會說上一兩句話。但由於幾乎都是英語，綾瀨同學姑且不論，我完全不曉得他們在說什麼。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎顯得很放鬆，不像表演時那麼緊張。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說她看起來像鬆了口氣，或許比較正確。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　前面的瑠佳小姐像是早已習慣，擊了個掌就結束，還特地把我們往前推。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「來，妳很欣賞這兩個孩子吧？得和人家好好打聲招呼才行。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學被推到梅莉莎面前，像隻借來的貓一樣害羞地開口：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那個……妳唱得好棒。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，謝謝。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎的回應也是日語。到了這時，我才發現梅莉莎的日語意外地流暢。因為她在台上主要講英語，日語只用來打招呼，連剛剛那句「謝謝你們來」也讓我以為她只記了這句。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這樣啊，原來她會講。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　接著綾瀨同學努力地擠出了對於演唱會的感想。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎默默地聽。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯、嗯。妳講成這樣，會讓人不好意思耶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「呃，但是真的很棒。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「唉呀，畢竟做了不少練習嘛～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎謙虛地這麼說，一旁瑠佳小姐則是開玩笑地表示：「說是這麼說，但這傢伙正式上場前都緊張到臉色發青啦！」結果被梅莉莎用手肘頂了一下。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「好痛！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「妳很吵耶，瑠佳。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我說的都是真的呀！別害羞嘛。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　兩人打打鬧鬧，看起來交情很好。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「話說，瑠佳妳什麼時候認識他們兩個的？本來就認識？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「怎麼可能，剛剛才認識的。因為這位小妹妹……是叫沙季？她稱讚了我做的小冊子喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喔，那個啊。嗯，那個做得真不錯。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是的，很棒。樹林裡那棟看起來像建築物的東西，是哪裡的遺跡嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那是哪裡啊？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到綾瀨同學的問題，梅莉莎也跟著詢問瑠佳小姐。結果瑠佳小姐反過來問綾瀨同學：「妳覺得是哪裡？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學想了一下──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「一開始看到叢林，沒多想就覺得是亞馬遜之類的地方。然而，稍微思考一下就認為應該不是。我想，大概是亞洲某處──歐亞大陸偏南的風景。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「為什麼會這麼想？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span
