style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我把筷子放進碗裡。撈起豆腐時，沉澱的味噌像煙一般變了個模樣晃蕩。綾瀨同學做的豆腐味噌湯，豆腐大小適中，老爸做的則稍微大了點。豆腐本身味道淡所以適合火鍋，但如果把兩公分大小的豆腐塊放進味噌湯裡，咬起來就會是滿口豆腐味。味噌的味道都不曉得跑哪裡去了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　原來如此，豆腐的大小很重要──我寫到心裡的料理筆記上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在我想著要如何提升自己的料理技能時，綾瀨同學突然開口。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「今年的文化祭要怎麼辦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　怎麼辦是指？我用不明白話中含意的眼神詢問。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「記得嗎？去年我們只有在樓梯上碰個面而已，沒有一起逛。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「對喔，那也是一年前的事了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在意周圍目光的我們，當時就像做虧心事一樣偷偷見面。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我覺得今年不需要藏……媽媽他們都說了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊……這麼說來──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　開口的是亞季子小姐。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　月初就把文化祭的日期告訴他們了。結果，亞季子小姐說今年一定要看看女兒盛裝打扮的模樣，為了參加文化祭而請假。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「知道我們班是『女僕＆管家咖啡廳賭場』之後就更堅持了呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「她啊，似乎是因為工作的關係，想看我接待客人。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　話又說回來，女兒穿女僕裝算不算盛裝打扮還是個問題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「還說『想看妳和悠太一起在模擬店工作』。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「如果想看接待客人，明明去打工的地方就行了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「說是這樣會打擾我們工作，所以不肯。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這倒也是。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　嗯，所以就是這樣，亞季子小姐為了文化祭申請特休。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　於是老爸說：「我也想去。」最後兩個人都要來。這對夫妻感情還是那麼好。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「明明去年和前年都沒來，亞季子小姐一說要來就跟著來，那個老爸……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「唉、唉呀，我想太一繼父應該也是本來就很在意，正好有了個機會吧。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是這樣嗎……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那個老爸，難不成只是想拿兒女當藉口和亞季子小姐約會？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以是週六？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。他們說那樣比較好請假。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　老爸本來週六就休假，如果亞季子小姐也休假，那麼兩個人都能來。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「現在講這個可能有點晚，不過我們其中一個週六負責接待客人或許比較好。畢竟老爸他們難得過來，要是見不到我們恐怕會很失望。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「應該說，既然是想看『兩個人一起工作』，選在我們兩個都負責接待客人的時候來不是比較好嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那麼，我們兩個最好都排在週六嘍。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就是這樣。淺村同學，你是申請哪個時段？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我嫌麻煩所以是週六的前半和後半。這麼一來隔天就完全空出來了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　文化祭為期兩天，還分成上午和下午，所以總共有四個工作時段。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　接待組成員在這四個時段裡必須排兩個時段的班。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我排在週六和週日的前半……我會找班長商量，看看能不能調班。可以的話我也空出整個週日了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是啊。畢竟不曉得老爸早上起不起得來嘛。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　既然如此，為了讓他們什麼時間來都可以，還是上下午都排班比較好。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我把文化祭行程刻進腦袋裡。從綾瀨同學的口氣聽來，她可能先前就有在考慮這些事。畢竟對策都直接提出來了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說完後，她垂下視線，接著又把頭抬起來。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「然後呢，這樣的話──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我已經大致猜到了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。如果在老爸和亞季子小姐來的時候出面迎接，一定會讓大家知道我們之間的關係。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　首先班上同學會知道。這點毫無疑問。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　那麼甜蜜的老爸和亞季子小姐，一邊調情一邊親密地和我們兩個說話。光是想像一下，就能肯定會引來眾人關注。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「只是熟人」這種說法不可能讓大家接受。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「然後，雖然懶得對班上的人一一解釋，不過大家應該猜得到，我們是沒有血緣的兄妹。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我想也是。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果到此為止還好，但是知道一對沒有血緣關係的高中男女住在一個屋簷下，難免會有人胡思亂想。不管怎麼說，沒有血緣關係的兄妹，在法律上是可以結婚的。雖然身為她的新家人，我一直盡量不去思考這個問題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那個……在消息傳開之前，我想先讓幾個人知道。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我點點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　對於有私交的人，與其讓他們聽些夾雜臆測的傳聞，倒不如自己講清楚。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我們是沒有血緣的兄妹，這件事真綾當然知道，但我還沒告訴班長和佐藤同學。這讓我……有點介意。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我以旁觀者的角度，將教室裡的非日常景象盡收眼底。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到吉田的聲音，我回過頭去。看來輪到男生量尺寸了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我只是在想，如果是換成去年以前的我，對於文化祭準備工作恐怕不會奉陪到這種地步。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們將學校制服換成書店制服，來到賣場。綾瀨同學和小園同學負責收銀台，我和讀賣前輩將雜誌存貨擺到架上。</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　『食慾之秋　邊走邊吃約會特輯！新大久保ＶＳ原宿　甜點對決！』</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　喔，邊走邊吃約會啊？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽起來像是我和綾瀨同學不會去做的事。總覺得以我們的作風來說，與其邊走邊吃還不如坐進店裡。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我發現嘍，只要在後面加上『前輩』，我就會把注意力放在『前輩』而不是名字上面，這麼一來就沒問題了。我和悠太前輩的距離縮短啦！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然她一臉得意，但再怎麼說都還是把我當成前輩，感覺距離也沒縮短多少。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學則是若無其事地說：「那很好啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　該不會出主意的人是……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　接下來我就和讀賣前輩站收銀台直到下班。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「剛剛你回來時，臉是不是有點紅？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　將收工時綾瀨同學的質疑蒙混過去，毫無疑問是今天打工最艱鉅的任務。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學並肩走在已經徹底暗下來的回家路上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們牽著手邊走邊聊的內容，多半是一些日常瑣事，不過今天終究還是聊文化祭比較多。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　沒想到不止父母，就連讀賣前輩和小園同學也要來。而且看樣子我們非得接待他們不可。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「梅莉莎好像也能來。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，她的行程應該沒問題。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學邀請梅莉莎時，她似乎只說「如果在停留期間內說不定能去」。而現在好像已經確定沒有別的安排。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　必須迎接的人變多了呢。文化祭的時候可有得忙了──就在我這麼想時，手機響起來訊通知音。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學的手機也幾乎在同一時間響起。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　ＬＩＮＥ的家人群組收到訊息。老爸發的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　【今天要加班，會很晚回家，你們先吃晚飯。睡覺前記得把門鎖好。】</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　呃，也就是說……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學揚起手機說道：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「太一繼父發了訊息。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我正在看。看樣子他恐怕要深夜才會到家。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「是啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「也就是說，今天就剩下我們兩個人了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我這才注意到。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　亞季子小姐有調酒師的工作，已經出門上班。要加班的老爸則會晚歸。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　當然，以前也碰過這種狀況。去年這個時候，正值老爸工作最忙的時期，晚上家裡常常只有我們兩個人。正因如此，老爸也和往常一樣，只發一道訊息就完事。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　只不過，和去年不一樣的地方在於──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學的關係。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　回家路上，我們兩個多半都很緊張。明明一直牽著手，打開家門時彼此的視線卻始終沒有對上，做晚飯時也只有最低限度的對話。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　即使處於這種狀態，手依然沒有停。我將高麗菜和洋蔥切絲，淋上醬汁。綾瀨同學用剩菜做了味噌湯。要煮飯也很麻煩，所以我是把冷凍的白飯解凍後裝進碗裡。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　合掌說完「我開動了」之後，我們同時伸出筷子。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　此時我不經意地抬起頭，看見綾瀨同學背後的澀谷夜空。低矮的雲朵，在都會燈火映照下閃閃發亮。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我看著窗上綾瀨同學的背影，腳尖在桌下悄悄地試圖滑動。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就在採取行動的前一刻，有東西碰到我的腿。小腿上有種柔軟的觸感。我發現那是綾瀨同學的腳尖。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　就這樣按照一定的節奏，輕輕地用腳尖戳。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學正若無其事地用筷子撥弄竹莢魚。然而，這毫無疑問是我們事先所決定的暗號。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　正準備回應暗號時，我才終於發現問題所在。我的天啊，我們先前的接吻、擁抱等行為，從未帶有這種意圖，只是為了確認彼此的愛情。不過現在這麼做，恐怕無論如何都會意識到梅莉莎的那番話吧？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我偷偷打量綾瀨同學。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她在想什麼呢？可是到了這個地步，綾瀨同學依然掛著那張撲克臉，只是默默地撥弄竹莢魚。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　即使如此，我也知道這個時候不該拒絕。如果換成我，在這種時候被拒絕多半會受傷。當然，假如一方邀約另一方必須回應，那根本不用談什麼磨合，所以有正當理由要拒絕應該也行就是了。不過真要說起來，我本來也想打暗號的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一時之間，我不知如何是好。我同樣用腳尖戳了回去。也不知道鬆了口氣的人究竟是我、是綾瀨同學，或者是我們兩個。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這個家裡現在只有我和綾瀨同學，說真的沒必要為了避人耳目打暗號──這樣的正論，對於沒辦法像梅莉莎那樣的我們來說毫無意義。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不，說不定是是習慣問題。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學頭也不抬地小聲說道：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「可以晚一點。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我默默點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「像是洗完澡後。在那之前我想先念書。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　對於這個提議我也很贊成，不過問題是我現在的心理狀況還能不能好好念書。話雖如此，但就我的立場而言──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我知道了……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　只能這樣回答。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　洗完碗盤後，我們各自窩回房間。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　無論如何，我們終究仍是考生。今天要複習的是數學，我翻開教科書和問題集。好啦，我真的能忘掉和綾瀨同學的事，專心念書嗎……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　嗯，反正這本問題集已經做過一遍，我會專注在那些以前沒解出來的問題上，應該不至於花太多力氣──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　……鬧鐘聲驚醒了我。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　真令人驚訝。儘管剛開始的幾分鐘心浮氣躁，但在下定決心開始閱讀題目後，我的腦袋便自動進入專注狀態。沒想到這麼簡單就能把雜念逐出意識。該怎麼說呢，反而讓我覺得很對不起綾瀨同學。這麼說來，打從小時候被老爸帶到圖書館遇上那些書起，我好像就成了會看書看到脫離現實的孩子。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不，大概要反過來，或許是養成了一面對壓力就逃進書本裡的性格。呃，這樣很糟啊。真要說起來，光是會拿壓力這種負面的東西來類比，恐怕就和梅莉莎所謂的「幸福行為」差得很遠。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　……差不多該去洗澡了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　感覺自己快要掉進思考也不會有答案的深坑，因此我決定趕快洗澡。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我先知會綾瀨同學一聲，接著去洗澡，洗完後待在餐廳喝麥茶。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　喊了聲「我洗好嘍」之後，綾瀨同學便換班似的穿過走廊進入浴室。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我看向牆上的時鐘。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　已經晚上十點。老爸還沒回來。看來他真的要過了十二點才會到家。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我回房間看書。最近忙著準備考試，堆著沒看的書變多了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　《社會數據科學入門》。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　標題艱深的厚重書籍。作者是森茂道，換句話說，就是和工藤副教授待在一起的那位教授。我在打工的書店試著找了一下，發現架上有擺。只不過雖說是入門，內容卻是大學生取向，相當難懂。也不知是不是因為這樣，我發現自己總是讀不進去，感到一頭霧水。原來如此，並不是只要有書就能轉移注意力。說穿了我也是個普通……</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　敲門聲響起。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「可以進去嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到綾瀨同學的聲音，我有些沉不住氣地走到門前回答：「可以啊。」然後開門迎接她。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　剛洗好澡的綾瀨同學，雙手各拿了一個馬克杯。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她還沒換成睡衣，而是Ｔ恤短褲這種平常的穿著。雖然是露肩Ｔ恤，但為了避免著涼，她披上灰色的薄外衣。一頭長髮應該已經吹過，但還是帶了點水氣。</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「呃，我剛剛泡的。喝嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「紅茶？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯。畢竟是睡前，所以我泡了無咖啡因的。那個……如果你方便，我想稍微聊一下……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我道謝後接過杯子，以眼神示意她進房間。綾瀨同學走進來關上門，然後直接坐到床上。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「明明也可以坐椅子上。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「總覺得那應該是淺村同學的位置。我坐這裡就好。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　儘管她大概是客氣，但只有我坐在好坐的椅子上，感覺也不太對。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　此外，綾瀨同學喊我「淺村同學」，這點我也沒漏掉。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這也是理所當然的。因為用暗號徵求同意，是為了「在家裡有時也會想當情侶」所做的決定。如果她在這時喊著悠太哥抱上來，就成了「在維持兄妹角色同時確認男女之間的愛情」這種感覺更加危險的場面。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著，我坐到綾瀨同學身旁。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　稱做大理石花紋的圖案應該很多人知道。大理石上頭有種紋路，很像水性顏料溶於水時會出現那種扭來扭去的曲線。故意將顏料溶於液體製造那種圖案，再讓它印到底紙上，就成為流體畫。流體圖案中有可能產生零碎的氣泡，所以也有人稱它為氣泡畫。某些圖因為帶有大量氣泡，會讓密集恐懼症患者有些排斥。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「你知道？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我對美術沒那麼熟悉就是了，頂多曉得些基礎知識。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　瑠佳小姐的ＩＧ上除了流體畫之外，也有些用身邊小東西組合而成的立體藝術照。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我雖然缺乏藝術方面的美感，但是想要貼近綾瀨同學那種「我喜歡這個！」的心情，因此試著正面看待這些圖片……然後，以自己的話說出覺得好的部分。</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「或許是吧。畢竟老爸原本就不是這麼細膩的人，是最近受到亞季子小姐影響才變得好一點，所以當時他們不會特地為了吵架外出，總是在起居室吵。如果當時的我沒有讀書這個嗜好，能逃避的地方大概就只剩電視。而電視擺在起居室，老爸和那個人當然也在。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　換句話說，回家後我不得不一直看著老爸和生母的爭吵場面，要不然就只能去念書。但是，當時的我不怎麼會念書，面對書桌同樣很痛苦。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「所以，遇到書本、逃向書本，對我來說是種救贖。也多虧如此，我的成績漸漸有了起色，最後連念書也成為避風港。就這樣我透過書本學到世界會改變，凡事無論好壞都不會永遠持續下去。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這對你來說是種救贖啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我認為是這樣。所以我對於帶來這種變化的原因、狀況等很感興趣。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　是因為什麼而產生變化呢？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果能夠明白這點，就可以提前對產生的變化做好心理準備──儘管我並非因此選擇志願學部，但是以結果來說，我的心底深處或許有這種念頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「就某方面來說，可能吧。一個總是用嘲諷口吻說著『美好事物遲早要結束』的傢伙，不是囂張又討人厭嗎？真虧丸願意奉陪我這種人。」</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　可能是考慮到時間很晚吧，老爸聲音小得好像不期待有回應。聽到之後，我們連忙分開。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一看時鐘，已經過了深夜零點。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們還沒更進一步。不過，直接碰觸彼此的肌膚也已經是種未知的體驗，足以填滿我的心。雖然並非不覺得可惜，但情況不允許，因此我連忙整理好衣服，離開房間往家門移動。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　必須為沙季爭取回房的時間才行。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，你還沒睡啊？我剛進家門。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我慰問老爸的辛勞，順便問他要不要吃晚飯。不出所料，他說已經吃過了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　於是我一邊擋住走廊，一邊將老爸推進洗手間要他先洗個手。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　教室以布幕區隔前後，後面一半是後場。當然，桌椅堆在更後方。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　好啦，開始營業。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學站在布幕邊緣，看著走進教室的顧客。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　排班的七人裡，五人去為剛進門的顧客點餐，等到新客人進來就輪到我們。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我偷偷瞄向身旁的綾瀨同學，她正好也轉頭看我。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「怎麼了？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，沒有啦……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在側邊等待的只有我們兩個，沒別人。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　所以我壓低聲音說道：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「很適合妳。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　順帶一提，店裡的女僕裝沒有統一。一間店的制服不統一，在現實的咖啡廳來說實在不太可能，但我們這些女僕裝和管家服畢竟只是借來再修改一下而已，能湊到款式類似的已經很不容易了。唉，高中的文化祭也就這樣吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「謝謝。雖然我不怎麼喜歡荷葉邊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她略微提起裙襬，同時這麼說道：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「淺村同學也很帥。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她反過來稱讚我穿上管家服的模樣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這也是理所當然的吧，這種經典的服裝誰穿起來都人模人樣。雖然這麼想，但如果我直接如此回答，她恐怕會說女僕裝也一樣，所以我沒講出口。畢竟這麼一來就失去了讚美的意義，何況真的很適合她。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「謝謝。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我只回了這一句。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們站在側邊打量咖啡廳區域。顧客數量目前還不怎麼多。占據半個教室的咖啡廳區，中央擺了遊戲桌，周圍則是飲食區。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果每一桌都有得玩，翻桌率會很差，所以我們將遊戲桌安排得像表演一樣，讓顧客能夠邊吃邊看。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　順帶一提，文化祭的店舖不收現金，要用在學校入口買的票券支付。把票券當成只能在文化祭用的鈔票就行了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　開店所需的經費由學生負擔，學生負擔的份則是拿收據從校方收的票券費用那邊領取一定程度的回饋。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這麼一來，學生們會將花費壓在限度之內，收益也不至於過高。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　賭場也只是用兌換券遊玩的小遊戲，理所當然不會支付現金給顧客。照理說可以輕鬆玩，但考慮到周圍有觀眾，願意挑戰的人實在不多。這也在意料之內。如果遊戲桌擠了太多人，會讓顧客在店裡停留過久。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　……因此，我提議將動線分開，避免顧客進出頻繁導致場面混亂。出主意的當然是讀賣前輩。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「沙季、淺村同學，拜託了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　唉呀，好像有人在叫我們。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學替一對看似高中生的情侶帶位，我負責他們後面的親子──小學生年紀的男孩，另一個應該是他媽媽。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「歡迎──」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　男孩一臉疑惑地看著我。糟糕，管家與主人這種玩法對小學生來說太早了嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看準他們坐下後，我遞上菜單。說是這麼說，不過高中文化祭能端出來的餐點畢竟有限，都是些不用火就能搞定的。即使如此，對小孩來說依舊像是廟會的攤販一樣，應該會很興奮吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「兩位，剛回來就要麻煩你們實在很抱歉，幫忙把這個端出去！淺村同學的是三號桌，綾瀨同學那一份要送到二號桌喔！」</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我接過的托盤上，擺著香蕉可麗餅與紙杯裝可樂共兩份。至於三號桌，則是靠近門的桌子。</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「久等了，大小姐。這是妳們的香蕉可麗餅與可樂。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span
