style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我鞠躬後離開這一桌，但心裡還是吃了一驚。管家裝扮有這麼稀奇嗎？大概很稀奇吧。也就是說，我們看起來像稀有動物？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我擦掉頭上的冷汗，在側邊等待下次出場。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學也回來了，我們兩個又是看著入口待命。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「喲～你們兩個都很會接待客人耶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　跑過來的班長這麼說道。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「會嗎……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「雖然說接待組是以有打工經驗的優先，不過你們在接待組裡面也算得上特別厲害喔，看。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說著，她偷偷指向店內。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一位看似ＯＬ的套裝美女大姊好像要搭訕吉田。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「真是的，拿他沒辦法。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　於是班長出面拯救吉田。她不知為何也穿著女僕裝，手臂上還掛著「女僕長」的臂章。只見那副半框眼鏡閃了一下，班長便揪著摸魚男服務生（大概是這種設定）的耳朵把他給帶回來了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　等確定不會被店內顧客看見後，班長立刻向吉田抱怨：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「吉田啊，所以說，你就不能應付得乾淨俐落一點嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「可是……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「之前說過了吧，我會向小牧告狀。居然被大姊姊迷得暈頭轉向，一臉色瞇瞇的表情。啊？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「哇，有夠恐怖。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　扮成女僕長的班長推高半框眼鏡說出這種話，實在太過適合，吉田會嚇到也是難免的。能夠感受到超出年齡的威嚴與風範。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，來了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到綾瀨同學的聲音，我回過頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　從側邊往入口看，正好見到讀賣前輩和小園同學進來。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「班長，那兩個是我的熟人，由我負責行嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯～？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　狠狠把接待守則壓在吉田腦袋上的班長轉過頭來，凶惡的眼神轉為柔和，臉上露出笑容。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「當然。去吧～」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「謝謝。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　離開側邊的綾瀨同學，前去迎接讀賣前輩和小園同學。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那麼，現在發牌。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　內心叫苦的我，站在中央桌旁將切好的牌發給參加者。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們班推出的「女僕＆管家咖啡廳賭場」正如其名，除了咖啡廳還有賭場。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　只不過雖說是賭場，能玩的遊戲種類卻不多，幾乎都是撲克，因為撲克的牌型應該比較多人認得出來。當然，也為不知道的人準備了寫有牌型的說明書。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　遊戲主持人由接待組有空的學生擔任。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　話說回來，實際開店之後狀況卻出乎意料。儘管已經做好準備，來賭場玩的客人卻比想像中來得少。只有中央擺一桌果然會導致大家讓來讓去，另一方面是不願成為眾人的焦點所以敬而遠之。擔心太多人所以只擺一張遊戲桌，造成了反效果。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「唔嗯嗯，真希望來幾個爽快一點的客人啊。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　班長這麼說完後，我便提議：「找熟人當暗樁怎樣？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　讓顧客實際看見別人玩得開心，想要參加的人應該也會變多。我是這麼想的。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　班長彈響手指說：「這個主意，我收下了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「好。淺村，拜託嘍。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「咦？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　禍從口出。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我還沒搞清楚這話什麼意思，班長已經進了咖啡廳區，還偏偏走向綾瀨同學接待的那一桌。換句話說，就是讀賣前輩和小園同學坐的那一桌。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然後以花言巧語哄騙她們下場玩。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　於是我被叫過去主持，就連綾瀨同學也接到命令要幫忙湊人數。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「話又說回來，這身裝扮很適合你耶，後輩。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「不能拍照……對吧？啊，晚點去後場偷偷拍幾張可以嗎？悠太前輩！」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「為什麼我……要做這種事。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我一邊偷瞄反應截然不同的三人，一邊從讀賣前輩開始發牌。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　玩的是「德州撲克」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這似乎是賭場採用的規則，在習慣前會有些不知所措。簡單地說明一下，大致是這種感覺：</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　首先，每一位玩家發兩張牌。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　發給玩家的那兩張牌，只有該玩家能看（不能讓其他人看見）。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「德州撲克」的玩法，就是以手裡兩張牌搭配擺在中央的五張公共牌，組成牌型。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果認為自己這一局會贏，那就支付賭金（籌碼）參加。覺得應該會輸，那就退出賭局（退出前下注的籌碼會被沒收）。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　基本規則只有這樣，不過桌子中央公開的牌起初只有三張，之後會一張一張增加，直到五張。而每次開牌都會逼迫玩家判斷要跟還是要棄，這段期間的勾心鬥角便是有趣之處。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「首先，請各位只看手裡的兩張牌決定是否參加賭局。如果手牌太差，放棄這次的賭局也ＯＫ。不過，持有莊家按鈕的人左邊那兩位強制下注，這些強制下注的籌碼就算退出一樣會被沒收，還請注意。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　儘管三人都知道規則，我依舊在主持遊戲同時進行簡單的說明。至於為什麼不省略說明？當然是因為這一局還要用來對周圍的客人們宣傳。</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　看完牌的三人全都露出自信滿滿的表情，隱藏得很漂亮。開始後沒多久，我就發現她們都相當厲害。</span></span><br><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一般來說，「德州撲克」的遊玩人數好像是兩人到十人，但是遊戲桌沒那麼大，六人就坐滿了。我和綾瀨同學在徵求班長的許可後，獲准一邊接待店內的客人一邊在旁為兩人服務。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　最後的順位是瑠佳小姐第一，梅莉莎第六。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　梅莉莎宣稱有在新加坡的賭場實戰過，但她總是在下重注後自爆虧輸，因此用光了籌碼提前投降，讓瑠佳小姐很無奈。唉，畢竟梅莉莎只要有人在自己面前加注就一定跟著加，也不管自己的牌好不好，這種玩法原本能贏的也贏不了。雖然她或許是出於娛樂精神想要炒熱氣氛也說不定。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　瑠佳小姐則是透過觀察局勢及冷靜地管理籌碼贏得勝利。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　不用回頭也知道。老爸和亞季子小姐來了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　即使如此，「曾經存在過」這個事實依舊不會消失。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽著手機響起的快門聲，我在想──能以這樣的四人陣容迎接高中最後的文化祭，這件事我恐怕到死都不會忘記吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><img loading="lazy" src="https://res.lightnovel.fun/images/260521/e3bb44011acc5a3b7eca3ade746649a3.jpg?m=FhbB1Sxot1kW1ch5n5Qy5g&amp;t=1781007686" img-width="1384" img-height="2048" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;"><br>　　當天晚上──<br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　回到家，和等我們回來的老爸與亞季子小姐吃晚飯時，他們再次稱讚我們今天的表現很棒。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學亮出奈良坂同學透過ＬＩＮＥ傳過來的照片。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　於是又引起了熱烈討論。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　吃完飯後，綾瀨同學先一步去洗澡。我正準備回房時，被亞季子小姐叫住。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她低頭道謝，讓我一時慌了手腳。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「看見她在學校開心地和大家打成一片，讓我放下了心頭大石。謝謝你。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，不。我什麼也沒做。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　亞季子小姐輕輕搖頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「一定是多虧了悠太。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　她接著又開心地告訴我「沙季說今後要拍照也可以」、「沙季說以後想用照片多保留些回憶」。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我隱約感覺得到，綾瀨同學已經克服心裡的難關了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然說，我對亞季子小姐開心的表情和那句「今後也請多指教嘍」點了點頭，但在放下心頭重擔的同時，我不禁又想，說不定我和綾瀨同學所做的事，會毀掉這張笑臉。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我不想這樣。正因如此，不得不思考。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　明天，我和綾瀨同學將以情侶身分度過高中最後的文化祭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我們不想後悔。所以決定要在文化祭約會。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　然而──我也有種「還沒克服難關」的感覺。更大的問題是，我自己也不清楚那是什麼難關。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　回到房間，我一邊翻單字集一邊思索。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果，那天老爸沒回來，我們會更進一步嗎？</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我停下動作，看向桌上，班長謹製的「接待守則」映入眼簾。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　接待有守則，情侶交往卻沒有。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　或許有類似的東西，但即使如此，也無法保證不會發生意外，這就是名為現實的開放世界遊戲。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　感覺自己像個被迫拿檜木棒與惡龍戰鬥的勇者。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　雖然我是個喜歡接觸新觀點的人，然而要走向自己所未知的領域時，卻又是這麼地無助。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　或者──</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　對於新手戀愛冒險者來說，只要不前進，就解不了這個任務？</span></span><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><div class="inline-align-left"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　　　<b>10月10日（星期日）　淺村悠太</b><br></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　文化祭第二天。光是穿過水星高中的門，就能感受到慶典的興奮氣氛。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　久違的大晴天，萬里無雲。各個地方拉起的萬國旗，在總算宣告秋天已到的清風吹拂下晃動。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　登上和緩的坡道，在校舍前停步，好啦，接下來要從哪裡逛起呢──我和綾瀨同學商量。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　從一樓開始照順序逛一圈。果然大多是常見的鬼屋和咖啡廳。由於不能用火，加熱食物頂多只能靠加熱板或微波爐，但即使如此，大家依舊端出了可麗餅和飲料，甚至還有雞蛋糕。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「都沒想到雞蛋糕呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「好吃。要是我們的店也有賣這個就好了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說不定去年、前年也有，但是我沒注意到。雖然我直到去年為止都還不怎麼關心文化祭，根本無從注意就是了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　人實在有夠多。大概也和學校離車站近有關吧。碰到星期日，一般訪客的人數好像也變多了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　攤位種類感覺也比去年多出一些。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　部分班級只有展示，其中有一處展示引起了我的興趣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　內容是將無人機帶進體育館，從各種角度拍攝班上同學的舞蹈和球技。出乎意料地有趣。光是從陌生角度去看些習以為常的東西，就會有不同印象。雖然他們的展示很樸素，就只是在教室內擺螢幕不斷重複播放影片，但我想頒給他們創意獎。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　說到文化祭，也是文化系社團發表成果的場合。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　與校舍平行而建，別名「特別教室棟」的第二校舍，物理社在此展示機器人、化學社則進行五顏六色的化學實驗。此外還有天文照片與化石的展示。社團大樓則有茶道社點茶。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學想去看看，不過很遺憾那裡擠滿了人，實在進不去。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　美術教室擺上了美術社員的力作。儘管應該是偶然，但裡面也有流體畫。是最近的流行嗎？就在綾瀨同學看著那些畫時，一名社員走來，提醒我們展示作品的邊緣有二維條碼。看來美術社是將作品拍照後放上ＩＧ，讓大家隨時都能閱覽。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「對這些有興趣嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「嗯，最近有點興趣……」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學這麼回答後，對方便告知近期會有幾項展覽。可能這位社員也喜歡吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　到體育館聽了一下管樂社的演奏後，回到校舍。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我和綾瀨同學在咖啡廳攤位吃了炒麵，填飽肚子後，前往丸和奈良坂同學的班級。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　時機湊巧，剛好有位置。於是我們參加了逃脫遊戲。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　似乎是四人到六人一組。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　教室內分成四個房間，如果在限制時間內解開了該房間的謎題，就能前往下一個房間；沒解開則到此結束，領取一張寫著「安慰獎」的卡片並回到走廊。哭泣小貓的圖案很可愛，就算沒解開謎題，這張卡片大概也足以讓人接受。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我試著向綾瀨同學提議。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　特別教室棟的逃生梯最高處。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　去年之所以選那裡，是因為離文化祭的喧囂最為遙遠。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　若是那裡，我覺得今年應該也能度過一段悠閒時光。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學也贊成，所以我們拿著領到的獎品飲料，造訪去年曾經打擾的地方。一年前這裡的風很冷，不過今年還沒有冷到那種地步。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　其他學生的吵鬧聲，攀上了我們所在的最高處。耳邊隱隱聽得到的樂聲，大概是來自募集志願者參加的搖滾樂團吧？還是輕音社？輕快的樂音，融入即將日落的天空，消失無蹤。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「淺村同學，你一臉鬆了口氣的表情呢。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到綾瀨同學這麼說，我不禁苦笑。實際上就是這樣。我鬆了口氣。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「在文化祭以情侶身分約會」這點雖然和去年有所不同，但我終究不怎麼喜歡人擠人，還是這種沒什麼人的地方比較能讓我安心。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　有些地方變了，也有些地方沒變呢──我們相視而笑，喝起領到的飲料。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　太陽的殘渣化為紅光照耀雲朵。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　橘色的天空逐漸轉為深藍。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　擴音器傳出「喀哩喀哩」的聲音，告知水星高中文化祭結束的廣播隨之響起，引導訪客離開。再過三十分鐘，校門就會暫時關閉。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　接下來是只屬於水星高國中生的時間。營火等著我們。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「要參加嗎？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我詢問之後，綾瀨同學點點頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「機會難得。我也想留下和你共舞的回憶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「那麼，先去教室幫忙收拾善後吧。要是在這裡等上將近一小時，恐怕身體都要冷掉了。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「也對。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　這麼說來，去年我們買的是熱飲，不過奈良坂同學給的獎品是冷飲。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　回到教室後，班長驚訝地問：「欸？怎麼啦？」這也是難免的，畢竟我和綾瀨同學今天完全不用做事，她大概沒想到我們會特地來幫忙收拾吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「打發時間呀。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「啊，對喔。你們兩個都要參加營火晚會嘛。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　班長十分敏銳。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一會兒後天空染成深藍，操場搭起了高台並點火。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在水星高中的校史中，似乎有一段時間因為危險而暫停舉辦營火晚會。據說讓它復活的是前前任學生會長，必須感謝以前的學生會長才行。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　學生們開始集合，我和綾瀨同學也加入隊伍。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　擴音器開始播放跳舞用的音樂。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　如果是熟悉的樂曲就好了。不過看來並非小學時代臨時抱佛腳學過的土風舞樂曲，只能邊看邊學了。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「彼此的身體好像要再靠近一點喔。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　聽到綾瀨同學這麼說，我便將她拉到身邊。雖然舞步相當隨便，但我們勉強還維持在不至於和周圍相差太多的程度。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「我們這麼光明正大地貼在一起，看起來會像是什麼關係啊？兄妹？又或是比較像情侶？」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「這就不曉得了，雖然我覺得好像都有可能。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　我雖然回答了綾瀨同學的問題，實際上卻沒辦法冷靜地思考答案。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　因為想起了日前那次碰到她肌膚的觸感。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　感受胸部隆起與腰部緊貼的同時，彼此也都保持愜意的節奏持續舞動。據說很久很久以前，慶典的舞蹈是為了評估男女是否相配，雖然我不曉得這說法是真是假。如果是真的，可能我們還挺適合的吧──我腦袋裡也有這樣的念頭。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　土風舞的圓圈繞著營火轉。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　男女互換位置，手牽著手相依而舞。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　一、二、三。這裡要牽著手交換位置。她進圓圈內側，我到圓圈外側。就這樣搖擺身體踩著腰際相貼的舞步。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　由於不需要換舞伴，所以我和綾瀨同學緊貼著彼此，在營火周圍一直跳下去。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　暗成這樣，說不定根本看不清楚誰和誰跳。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　只不過此時我在想，或許心底的某個角落，有著「讓人看見也無所謂」、甚至是「最好有人看見」這樣的念頭。因為我希望我們的關係更進一步。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「兄妹、情侶。或許看起來兩種都有可能，不過……我希望是情侶。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　「……嗯。」</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　互相碰觸對方的肌膚、交換彼此的體溫。當時在我們兩人之間的，並非原先擔心的下流慾望外顯，而是為了確認愛情實際存在所做出的行為，我敢肯定沒有半分虛假。實際上，也是碰觸彼此之後，我才明白這一點。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　現在也一樣。即使彼此緊貼，也不會受到下流欲望支配。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　沒問題。我會珍惜綾瀨同學，她也願意接受我。所以帶著自信向前進吧。從１級情侶升級吧。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　在晚風吹拂下，火星自中央高台飛上漆黑的夜空。</span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial">　　綾瀨同學的臉，在熱浪映照下閃著紅光。<br><br><img loading="lazy" src="https://res.lightnovel.fun/images/260521/a9eae1bf413c8345cc0bc81ca49eef5c.jpg?m=0yPfb9EE-7oM32Uc0tGFpg&amp;t=1781007686" style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　一想到現在要寫下的東西，就讓我猶豫是否真的要以文字將這件事記錄下來。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　可是，我必須把自己腦中所想的言語化才行。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　明明是自己的事，卻感覺自己快要搞不懂了……不，或許已經搞不懂了。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　真綾也說我變呆了。真是過分，居然講這種話。我覺得她好過分，但是從另一方面來說，又好像能接受。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　因為，最近我在念書的空檔，腦袋裡想的都是這些。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　和他「兩情相悅」……梅莉莎那句話一直在耳邊迴盪。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　講得那麼明白，要不意識到根本不可能。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　一想像起男女之間的那種行為……我就會「嗚哇～」變成這樣。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　現在就是。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　嗚哇～</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　唉，冷靜點，綾瀨沙季。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　可是一旦鬆懈下來，就會去想這些。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　他的手。和女生的手不一樣，摸起來比較硬、比較大。抱在一起時也感受得到肩膀比較寬、胸膛厚而結實。儘管如此，他抱住我時力道依舊很輕很輕，怕我會痛。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　嗚哇～</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　……我為什麼都在寫他身體的觸感啊？</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　不是這樣。是這樣沒錯，但不是這樣。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　渴望肢體接觸的我，原本只要擁抱就心滿意足，但是今天終於……</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　……好，寫吧。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　是他開口的。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　問我：「可以更進一步嗎？」</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　原來我們想的一樣啊。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　於是我們……不止擁抱，還有了更深的接觸。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　光是回想就覺得好害羞。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　果然不該寫日記嗎？是不是該立刻把這些燒掉或撕掉啊？</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　唉，不過，都決定要繼續寫了嘛。試著努力一下吧。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　10月９日（星期六）</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　今天是文化祭第一天。雖然累卻很有趣。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　和讀賣小姐、小園同學的撲克對決，最後讀賣小姐第一，小園同學第三。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　嗯，因為放棄了最後一局，所以我排第二。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　讀賣小姐故意示弱，這點我有發現，但她的牌也沒有強到一定會贏。之所以發現我和小園同學不怎麼加注，卻還是沒有押下大量籌碼，則是認為只要場上出了好牌就會瞬間逆轉。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　由此可以推測，她應該是拿了相當大的對子。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　因為場上開出的前三張是３、４、５。和這幾張牌湊成的對子算不上強。她手裡那兩張大概不小於10。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　到這邊為止是猜得到的部分。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　這種情況下，最強的牌是Ａ一對。換句話說，四張Ａ裡的兩張，正好都發到讀賣小姐手裡──這是我所能想到的最糟發展。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　如果是這樣就贏不了。我手上是２和５，這時間點只有５一對。第四張是Ｊ，我依然是５一對，就算第五張來２也贏不了Ａ一對。如果來５就是三條，但是場上已經有另一張了，所以機率很低。最佳情況是來Ａ，這樣的話就是順子，即使對方三條也能贏。不過，假如四張Ａ裡面已經有兩張在讀賣小姐手裡，機率就會比５還要低。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　考慮到這裡，我決定棄牌。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　然而，最後的第五張牌偏偏是紅心Ａ。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　如果沒棄牌就是順子。即使讀賣前輩是Ａ三條也能贏。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　我啊，也是那種會在關鍵時刻退縮而錯失勝利的人。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　遇上讀賣小姐這種運氣好的對手，不正面對決的話是不會贏的……至少不能在氣勢上輸掉。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　在那之後，梅莉莎和瑠佳小姐來了。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　兩人都是喝不加糖不加奶精的黑咖啡，好成熟。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　接著，媽媽和太一繼父要來。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　自己的媽媽和淺村同學的爸爸再婚，這件事我已經向班長和佐藤同學坦白。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　這麼做需要很大的勇氣。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　因為這等於將「沒有血緣的男女住在一個屋簷下」這個敏感的事實告訴她們。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　老實說，我無法肯定班長和佐藤同學能夠像真綾那樣不放在心上。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　需要勇氣。我覺得自己很努力了。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　結果，太一繼父他們照約定來了。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　媽媽甚至很捧場地說想讓店裡雇用我們。她講得太誇張了。我可不認為自己能像媽媽那樣對誰都和善。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　這個嘛，如果是淺村同學……應該行吧。他遠比我更懂得為客人著想。媽媽好像說想幫他買套西裝。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　他穿西裝感覺很適合。應該很帥吧。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　真綾和丸同學在我們收工時來了。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　那兩個人感情真的很好耶。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　我們四個一起拍照，真高興。真綾知道我討厭拍照，一開始還問得小心翼翼。不過在我答應之後，她笑得好開心。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　沒想到她會這麼開心，我該早一點說ＯＫ的。總有種自己因為愛逞強反倒吃了虧的感覺。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　這麼說來，那時候真綾好像是用名字稱呼丸同學。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　雖然淺村同學似乎沒注意到就是了。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　原來他們這麼要好……話說回來，就連成了情侶的我和淺村同學都沒用暱稱耶。暱稱啊……既然是悠太……「阿悠」？還是直接叫他「悠」呢？</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　呃，為什麼我光是想像要用怎樣的暱稱就這麼興奮啊？</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　總之，今後慢慢地習慣拍照吧。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　我已經和淺村同學約好，明天要來場文化祭約會。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　好期待。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><br><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"><b>　　</b>10月10日（星期日）</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000"></span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: #000000">　　文化祭第二天。</span></span></span></div><br><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"></span></span><br><div align="justify"><span style="font-size:large"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color: style="font-family:Arial">　　好啦，關於這一集的內容，閱讀《義妹生活》到現在的各位，說不定會感到非常驚訝──這兩個人，居然做出那種事。另一方面，或許也會有人想「居然只到那種程度啊？」在這個系列，我完全不打算把「這種發展」當成一個單純用來消費的橋段。我會徹底排除「要回應某人的期待」、「要讓某人滿足」這樣的意圖，努力只讓悠太與沙季這兩個人面對面、走向彼此，自然地演變成那樣。兩個人的人生路繼續走下去，產生性方面的接觸是理所當然的，然而那些行為並不是為了讓某個觀測者看見，恐怕不見得能夠描寫到讓人滿足。我能承諾的，就只有絕對不會隨便處理兩人關係的變化或進展。唯有這一點，還請各位相信我，希望各位今後能繼續守望兩人的人生。</span></span><br><span
